a: Velo haishsha bichtubbatah, velo habbanot bimzonotehen, velo et hayyavam, vechullam en notlin bashshevach velo barauy kevammuchezak.
Gemara may tama? amar kera: "velo mishpat habbechora" — mishpat habbechora laish, veen mishpat habbechora laishsha.
Veeno notel bashshevach. dichtiv: "bechol asher yimmatze lo", velo barauy kevammuchezak, dichtiv: "bechol asher yimmatze lo".
Velo haishsha bichtubbatah. ini? vehaamar shemuel: baal chov gove et hashshevach! amar rabbi abba: mikkulle chetubba shanu kan.
Velo habbanot bimzonotehen. may tama? tenay ketubba kichtubba dame.

Velo (et) hayyavam. may tama? "bechor" karyeh rachamana. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella beshevach sheshshavchu nechasim ben mita leyibbum, aval deven yibbum lachalukka — shakel. may tama? "yakum al shem achiv hammet" amar rachamana, vahare kam.
Rava amar: afillu deven yibbum lachalukka name la shakel, may tama? kivchor, ma bechor en lo kodem chalukka, af yavam name en lo kodem chalukka.
Vechullam en notlin bashshevach,
b: Leetoye shevacha demimmela: chafura vahavo shuvele, shalpufe vahavo tamre.
Velo barauy kevammuchezak, leetoye nichse daavi abba.
Mishna veellu sheen chozrin bayyovel — habbechora, vehayyoresh et ishto, vehameyaybem et eshet achiv.

Vehammattana — divre rabbi meir, vachachamim omrim: hammattana kammecher, rabbi elazar omer: kullam chozrin bayyovel, rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: af hayyoresh et ishto yachzir livne mishpacha, vinakke mehen et haddamim.

Gemara may tama derabbi meir? mecher hu deamar rachamana lehdar bayyovel, mattana virushsha la. vehane miyyerushsha — yerushsha, demattana — mattana. bechor — "latet lo pi shenayim", mattana karyeh rachamana.
Vehayyoresh et ishto, yerushshat habbaal deorayyta, vehameyaybem et eshet achiv — "bechor" karyeh rachamana.
Vachachamim omrim: mattana kemecher. may tamayyhu derabbanan? "tashuvu" — lerabbot et hammattana.
Vehane kullehu yerushsha ninhu.
Bechor amar kera: "latet lo pi shenayim", makkish chelek bechora lechelek pashut — ma chelek pashut yerushsha, af chelek bechora yerushsha.
Rabbi elazar omer: kullam chozrim bayyovel. savar la kerabbanan deamri: "tashuvu" lerabbot et hammattana, vehane kullehu mattana ninhu. bechor — "latet lo pi shenayim", mattana karyeh rachamana.
Vehayyoresh et ishto — yerushshat habbaal derabbanan, vehameyaybem et eshet achiv — "bechor" karyeh rachamana.
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: haachin shechalku lakochot hen, umachzirin ze laze bayyovel. motev rav hoshaya: veellu sheen chozrin bayyovel — habbechora!
Amar leh rabbi elazar: may "en chozrin" — en chozrin levattala. matkef la rav sheshet: mikkelal deman deamar "chozrin" — chozrin levattala kaamar?

Kare rav chama aleh derav sheshet: "tova chochma im nachala", vela shemia lehu ha dechi ate ravin amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la rabbi elazar amar mishshum rabbi elazar ben shammua: may "chozrin" — chozrin levattala.

Rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: af hayyoresh et ishto yachzir livne vechulei. may kasavar? i kasavar yerushshat habbaal deorayyta — ammay yachzir livne mishpacha? vei kasavar yerushshat habbaal derabbanan — damim may avidtayyhu?
Leolam kasavar yerushshat habbaal deorayyta, vehacha bemay askinan? kegon shehorishattu ishto bet hakkevarot, umishshum pegam mishpacha amur rabbanan: lishkol deme velayhdar.

Vechidtanya: hammocher kivro, vederech kivro, mekom maamado, uvet hespedo — baim bene mishpacha vekovrim oto beal korcho, mishshum pegam mishpacha. umay "yenakke lahem min haddamim"? deme kever ishto.
Hadaran alach yesh bechor.

a: Mishna masar behema noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit, bachullin aval lo bammukedashin. venoheg babbakar uvatztzon, veenan mitasserim mizze al ze. bakkevasim uvaizzim umitasserin mizze al ze.

Bechadash uvayyashan, veenan mitasserin mizze al ze. shehaya baddin, uma im hechadash vehayyashan sheenan kilayim ze baze enam mitasserin mizze al ze, kevasim veizzim shehen kilayim ze baze — eno din shello yehu mitasserin mizze al ze? talmud lomar: "vetzon", mashma kol tzon echad.

Gemara lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva? detanya, rabbi akiva omer: yachol yaale adam masar behema mechutza laaretz veyakrivennu? talmud lomar: "vahavetem shamma olotechem vezivchechem veet maserotechem".
Bishte maasrot hakkatuv medabber, echad masar behema veechad masar dagan, mimmakom sheatta maale masar dagan atta maale masar behema, umimmekom shei atta maale masar dagan i atta maale masar behema!
Afillu tema rabbi akiva, kan likrav, kan likdash. dayka name, deka nasev la talmuda "vahavetem shamma", shema minna.
I hachi, meachar sheeno karev, ammay kadosh? leneechol bemumo labbealim.
Bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit. i hachi, afillu haiddana name! kidrav huna, deamar rav huna: gezera mishshum yatom.
I hachi, meikkara name la! ella, efshar behacheraza. hacha name, efshar behacheraza!
Ella amar rabba: mishshum takkala, umena temra dechayyshinan letakkala? ditnan: en makdishin, veen maarichin, veen machrimin bazzeman hazze.
Veim hikdish veheerich vehechrim, behema — teaker, perot kesut vechelim — yerakvu, maot uchele mattachot — yolich leyam hammelach. veezehu ikkur? noel delet befaneha vehi meta meeleha.
I hachi, bechor name la likdosh! bechor bedidan talya milleta? berechem kadosh! hachi kaamar: likninhu leudenayyhu legoyim, dela likdosh meikkara!
b: Efshar kidrav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: muttar lo laadam lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyatza laavir haolam. hacha name, efshar deshade beh muma meikkara!
Mi yada he nafek? vechi tema demappek leh beresh asra — "lo yevakker ben tov lara" amar rachamana.
Vechi tema: efshar deshade beh muma bechulleh edreh — mehera yibbane bet hammikdash, uvaenan behema lehakerava velekka.
Hachi name bivchor behema, mehera yibbane bet hammikdash, uvaenan behema lehakerava velekka! efshar bifshutin.
Hacha name, efshar bilkuchin! kevan deihu shade beh muma bechulleh edreh, ushechichi mume defasyli bekadashim, daafillu dukkin shebbaayin name pasli — la shechichi.
Bachullin aval lo bammukedashin. mukedashin — peshita, lav dideh ninhu!

Bekadashim kallim, veallibba derabbi yose haggelili, deamar: kadashim kallim mamon bealim hem. detanya: "umaala maal baAdonai" — lerabbot kodashim kallim shehen mamon bealim, divre rabbi yose haggelili. salka datach amena liasseru, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! "yihye kodesh" amar rachamana, velo shekkevar kadosh.
Tama dichtav rachamana "yihye kodesh", ha lav hachi hava amena chayyla kedushshat maaser illavayhu? hasheta kedushsha chamura akkedushsha kalla la chayyla, kedushsha kalla akkedushsha kalla mibbaya?!
May hi? ditnan: echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit, en meshannin otam mikkedushsha likdushsha, aval makdishin otan hekdesh illuy, umachrimin otan.
Mahu detema: hatam, dechol behema lav leola kayyma, aval hacha, dechol behema lemaaser kayyma, af al gav deakdesha — la paka issura demaaser minna.
Lemay nafka minna? belo yiggael" uvelo yimmacher" ka mashma lan.

Venoheg babbakar uvatztzon, veen mitasserin mizze al ze, bakkevasim uvaizzim vechulei. veyihyu chadash veyashan mitasserin mizze al ze mikkal vechomer: uma kevasim veizzim shehem kilayim ze baze — mitasserin mizze al ze, chadash veyashan sheenan kilayim ze baze — eno din sheyyitasseru mizze al ze?

Talmud lomar: "asser teasser" bishte maasrot hakkatuv medabber, echad masar behema veechad masar dagan, umakkish masar behema lemaaser dagan: ma masar dagan mechadash al hayyashan lo, af masar behema mechadash al hayyashan lo.
I hachi, kevasim veizzim name lema: makkish masar behema lemaaser dagan — ma masar dagan mimmin al sheeno mino lo, af masar behema mimmin al sheeno mino lo? rabbi rachamana "tzon".
I hachi, chadash veyashan name! ha ketiv "asser teasser". uma raita? amar rava: amar kera "shana shana" — leshana hikkashtiv, velo ledavar acher.

Tenan hatam: en tormin mimmin al sheeno mino, veim taram — en terumato teruma. mena hane mille? amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yannay, veamri la amar rabbi amme amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: "kol chelev yitzhar vechol chelev tirosh vedagan" — amra tora: ten chelev laze vechelev laze.

a: Ashkechan tirosh veyitzhar, tirosh vedagan dagan vedagan minnayin? kal vachomer: uma tirosh veyitzhar sheenan kilayim ze baze — en mitasserin mizze al ze, tirosh vedagan dagan vedagan shehem kilayim ze baze — eno din shello yitasseru mizze al ze?
Ulerabbi yoshiyya, deamar: ad sheyyizra chitta useora vechartzan bemappolet yad, hechi mayyte la?

Mayyte la hachi: uma tirosh veyitzhar, sheenan kilayim ze baze afillu al yede davar acher — en mitasserin mizze al ze. tirosh vedagan dagan vedagan, shehen kilayim ze baze al yede davar acher — eno din shello yitasseru mizze al ze?
Ushene minin bealma, menalan? hane derabbanan ninhu, vechol detakkinu rabbanan keen deorayyta takkinu: ma deorayyta shene minin enan mitasserin mizze al ze, derabbanan name.
Amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye: ella meatta, gabbe maasar behema, dela ketiv "vechol masar bakar umaaser tzon",
b: Yitasseru mizze al ze! amar leh: amar kera "haasiri", ten asiri laze veten asiri laze. i hachi, kevasim veizzim name? "vatzon" mashma kol tzon echad.
Hacha name lema mashma kol dagan echad! amar abbaye: "reshitam", vechen amar rabbi ila: "reshitam".

Rava amar: bela "reshitam" name mashma kol dagan echad — la matzet amrat. bishlama hatam amrinan: "vatzon" mashma kol tzon echad, dei salka datach kevasim veizzim name — lichtov "vechol masar behema".
Vechi tema: i ketiv "kol masar behema", have amena afillu chayya — "tachat" "tachat" mikkodashim gamar.
Veate bekal vachomer mechadash veyashan, "bakar vatzon" lema li? bakar vatzon hu deen mitasserin mizze al ze, aval kevasim veizzim mitasserin.
Aval hacha, mi saggi dela ketiv "dagan"? lemaote shear minin.
Matkef la rav huna bereh derav nachman: ema learvu levakar betzon! amar leh mar zutera bereh derav nachman lerava: it leh name "haasiri".

Ikka deamri, amar rava: belo "asiri" name la matzet amrat bakar vatzon mitasserin mizze al ze, deittakkash masar behema lemaaser dagan — ma masar dagan mimmin al sheeno mino la, af masar behema mimmin al sheeno mino la.
Veha rava hu deamar: "shana" leshana hikkashtiv, velo ledavar acher! hadar beh rava mehahi. veibbaet ema: chada (minneh) [minayhi] rav pappa amra.

Mishna masar behema mitztaref kimlo regel behema roa, vechamma hi regel behema roa? shishsha asar mil. hayu ben ellu leellu sheloshim ushenayim mil — en mitztarfin. hayu lo baemtza — mevi umeasseran baemtza. rabbi meir omer: hayyarden mafsik lemasar behema.
Gemara mena hane mille?
Amar rabba bar shela: deamar kera "od taavorna hatztzon al yede mone", vekim lehu lerabbanan deshittesar mil ka shalta beh ena deroe.

Hayu ben ellu leellu sheloshim ushenayim mil en mitztarfin vechulei. sheloshim ushenayim hu deen mitztarfin, ha betzir mehachi mitztarfin? veha katane: shishsha asar mil, tefe la! mishshum deka vae lemitne sefa: hayu lo baemtza — mevi umeasseran baemtza.
Vechamma? amar rav: chamesh mikkan vechamesh mikkan vechamesh meemtza, dehane chamesh chazya lehacha vechazya lehacha.
Ushemuel amar: afillu chamesh mikkan vechamesh mikkan veechad baemtza, chazenan leroe keman dekae hacha, vekarenan beh "mone".

a: Metivi: haya lo chamesh bichfar chananya vechamesh bichfar otnay — en mitztarfot ad sheyyehe lo achat betzippori. teyuveta derav!
Targema shemuel allibba derav: kegon shehayu tesha mikkan vetesha mikkan veachat baemtza, dehahi chazya lehacha vechazya lehacha.
Amar rav pappa: velishmuel, afillu roe metzarfan, vaafillu kilyo shel roe metzarfan.
Bae rav ashe: kalba deroe may? kevan dekare leh veate la mitztarfi, o dilma zimnin dela ate, umitztarech ihu lemezal veetoyeh? teku.
Rabbi meir omer: hayyarden mafsik lemasar behema. amar rabbi amme: lo shanu ella sheen sham gesher, aval yesh sham gesher — gesher metzarfan.
Alma, mishshum dela meykarvan hu. metivi: hayu lo bishne evre hayyarden elach veelach, o bishne avtilaot kegon shel namer venamori — en mitztarfin, veen tzarich lomar chutza laaretz vaaretz.
Veha chutza laaretz vaaretz kimkom sheyyesh gesher dame, vekatane: lo mitztarfin!
Ella amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hayeynu tameh derabbi meir, deamar kera: "vehayyarden yigbol oto lifat kedma", hakkatuv asao gevul bifne atzmo.
Ella meatta, "vetaar haggevul" "veala haggevul", hachi name hakkatuv asao gevul bifne atzmo!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "zot tihye lachem haaretz ligvuloteha saviv", kulla eretz yisrael gevul echad hi.
I hachi, yarden name! "eretz" — velo yarden.
Bishlama lerabbi chiyyay bar abba — hayeynu dekatane "yarden", ella lerabbi amme — litninhu lechullehu neharot! kashya.
Lema ketannae: "ki attem ovrim et hayyarden artza kenaan", "artza" — eretz kenaan, velo hayyarden eretz kenaan, divre rabbi yehuda ben betira.
Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: hare hu omer "meever leyarden yerecho kedma mizracha", ma yerecho eretz kenaan, af yarden eretz kenaan.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: en "yarden" ella mibbet yerecho ulematta. lemay hilcheta? illema lenoder — hallech achar leshon bene adam, vechol hecha dekaru leh "yarden" ittesar leh! ella lemasar behema.

Tanya name hachi: yarden yotze mimmearat pamyays, umehallech beyammah shel sivchi, uveyammah shel teverya, uveyammah shel sedom, veholech venofel layyam haggadol, veen "yarden" ella mibbet yericho ulematta.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lamma nikra shemo "yarden"? sheyyored middan. amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe: attun mehatam matnitu la, anan mehacha matnenan la, "vayyikreu (lo) leleshem dan beshem dan avihem". veamar rabbi yitzchak: leshem zo pamyays, vetanya: yotze yarden mimmearat pamyays.
Amar rav kahana: zachruteh deyardena mimmearat pamyays, hecha deamar: "la shatena mayim mimmearat pamyays" — ittesar leh bechulleh yardena.
Zachruta didma — kavda, kidrabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: kaved shennimmoach — metamme birviit.
Zachruta demayya — perat, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: hannoder mimmeme perat — asur bechol memot shebbaolam.
Hechi dame? ilema deamar "la shatena mimmeme difrat" — me ferat hu dela shatena, ha minnahara acharina shatena.
Ella, deamar: "la shatena mimmayim deatu mipperat", deamar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hanneharot lematta mishshelosha neharot, ushelosha neharot lematta mipperat. vehaikka
b: Enata demiddalleyayn! amar rav mesharsheya: hanhu sullame difrat ninhu.
Veha ketiv: "vehannahar harvii hu ferat"!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, veittema rav acha bar yaakov: hu perat demeikkara.
Tanya, rabbi meir omer: "yuval" shemo, shenneemar: "vehaya keetz shatul al mayim veal yuval yeshallach shorashav", velamma nikra shemo "perat"? shemmemav parim veravim.
Mesayyay leh lishmuel, deamar shemuel: nahra mikkefeh mibberich. ufeliga derav, deamar rav amme amar rav: mitra bemareva sahada rabba perat.

Avu dishmuel aved lehu livnateh mikve beyome nisan, umappatze beyome tishre. mikve beyome nisan — savar la kerav, deamar rav amme amar rav: mitra bemareva sahada rabba perat, shemma yirbu notfin al hazzochalin, vehavu lehu me geshamim rubba.
Umappatze beyome tishre.
Ufeliga dideh addideh, deamar shemuel: en hammayim nitharim bezochalin ella perat beyome tishre.
Mishna hallokeach, o shennittan lo bemattana — patur mimmasar behema.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav kahana: deamar kera "bechor banecha titten li ken taase leshorcha letzonecha",

a: Ma banecha — en belakuach uvemattana, af tzoncha uvekarcha — eno belakuach uvemattana.
Vehay bivchor ketiv! amar kera: "ken taase", im eno inyan livchor, dela iteh baasiyyay, divrechem kadosh — tenehu inyan lemasar behema.
Veema: tenehu inyan lechattat uleasham! dumeya devincha — ma bincha sheeno ba al chet, af tzoncha veshorcha sheeno ba al chet.
Veema: tenehu inyan leola velishlamim! dumeya devincha — ma bincha sheeno ba beneder unedava, af tzoncha veshorcha kulei.
Veema: tenehu inyan leolat reiyyay! dumeya devincha — ma bincha sheen kavua lo zeman, af shorcha vetzoncha sheen kavua lo zeman.
I ma bincha eno belakuach kelal, af shorcha vetzoncha eno belakuach kelal, allema amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: lakach asara ubbarin bime imman — kullam nichnasin laddir lehitasser?
Amar rava, amar kera: "taase" — bishat asiyyay miet hakkatuv.
Gufa, amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: lakach asara ubbarim bime imman — kullan nichnasin laddir lehitasser. veha anan tenan: hallokeach o shennittan lo bemattana patur min masar behema!

Amar rabbi elazar: rabbi yochanan chazay bechelma, milleta mealleya amena. amar kera "taase", bishat asiyyay miet hakkatuv. etiveh rabbi shimon ben elyakim lerabbi elazar: hallakuach chal al mechussar zeman!

Amar leh: zo enah mishna, veim timtza lomar mishna — rabbi shimon ben yehuda hi mishshum rabbi shimon, deamar: mechussar zeman nichnas laddir lehitasser, vahare hu kivchor, ma bechor kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno — af mechussar zeman kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno.
Tane tanna kammeh derav: ezehu etnan shennichnas laddir lehitasser? kol shennetano lah vechazar ulekacho hemenna. veha ippesil leh belokeach!
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: lakach asara ubbarin bime imman — kullam nichnasin laddir lehitasser.
b: Vetiassere ihi! bezona goya.
Velokma bezona yisreelit, vetiassere ihi! ka mashma lan dezona yisreelit la have etnan.

Kidabbaye, deamar abbaye: zona goya — etnannah asur, vechohen habba aleha eno loke mishshum "lo yechallel zaro". zona yisreelit — etnannah muttar, vechohen habba aleha loke mishshum "lo yechallel zaro".
Zona goya etnannah asur — gamar "toeva" "toeva" mearayot.
Ma arayot, dela tafsi behu kiddushe — af zona, behach dela tafsi ba kiddushe.
Vechohen habba aleha eno loke mishshum "lo yechallel zaro", delo yechallel zaro amar rachamana, vehay lav zareh hu.
Mishna haachin vehashshuttafin, shechayyayvin bakkalbon — peturin mimmasar behema, chayyayvin bemasar behema — peturin min hakkalbon.
Kanu mittefisat habbayit — chayyayvin, veim lav — peturin. chalku, chazru venishtattefu — chayyayvin bakkalbon ufeturin mimmasar behema.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "yihye lecha" — velo shel shuttafut. yachol afillu kanu bitfisat habbayit? talmud lomar: "yihye".
Vehay bivchor ketiv! im eno inyan livchor, deha iteh beshuttafut, dichtiv: "uvechorot bekarchem vetzonchem", tenehu inyan lemasar behema.

Amar rabbi yirmeya: peamim shechayyayvin baze uvaze, ufeamim sheppeturin mizze umizze, peamim shechayyayvin bakkalbon ufeturin mimmasar behema, ufeamim shechayyayvin bemasar behema ufeturin min hakkalbon.
Chayyayvin baze uvaze — shechalku bakkesafim velo chalku babbehema, peturin mizze umizze — shechalku babbehema velo chalku bakkesafim.
Chayyayvin bakkalbon ufeturin mimmasar behema — shechalku baze uvaze.
Chayyayvin bemasar behema ufeturin min hakkalbon — shello chalku beze uvaze.
Peshita! chalku babbehema velo chalku bakkesafim itztericha leh, salka datach amena: kevan dechalku babbehema, gallo datayyhu dilmiflag kayymi, velichayyeyvu bekalbon — ka mashma lan.
Amar rav anan: lo shanu ella shechalku gedayim keneged teyayshim uteyayshim keneged gedayim.
Aval chalku gedayim keneged gedayim uteyayshim keneged teyayshim — omer ze chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach.
Verav nachman amar: afillu chalku gedayim keneged gedayim uteyayshim keneged teyayshim — en omrim ze hu chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach.
Verabbi elazar amar: lo shanu ella shechalku tisha keneged asara, vaasara keneged tisha.
Aval chalku tisha keneged tisha vaasara keneged asara — omer ze chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu chalku tisha keneged tisha, vaasara keneged asara, en omer ze chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach.

a: Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: haachin shechalku — lakochot hen, umachzirin ze laze bayyovel.

Utzerichi, dei ashmeinan hacha, beha kaamar rabbi yochanan dumeya devincha, ma bincha bevarur lach, af shorcha vetzoncha bevarur lach; aval sade mecher hu deamar rachamana lehdar beyovel, yerushsha umattana la!
Vei ashmeinan sade — lechumera, i name lechattechilla, aval hacha — ema la, tzericha.

Metivi: vechen hashshuttafin shechalku, echad natal asara veechad natal tisha vachelev — shekkeneged hakkelev asurin, sheim hakkelev muttarim. veim amrat yesh berera, livror chad minnayyhu levahade chelev velishkol, vehanach lishtero!
Amar rav ashe: i deshavu kullehu lahadade — hachi name, hacha bemay askinan? dela shavu kullehu lahadade, veshave hay kalba chad umashshehu, vehay mashshehu mashech veate bechullehu.

Mishna hakkol nichnasin laddir lehitasser, chutz min kilayim, uterefa, veyotze dofen, umechussar zeman, vehayyatom. veezehu yatom? kol shemmeta immah shennishchata veachar kach yalda. rabbi yehoshua omer: afillu nishchata immah vehashshelach kayyaym — en ze yatom.

Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "shor o chesev" — perat lechilayim, "o ez" — perat lenidme, "ki yivvaled" — perat leyotze dofen, "vehaya shivat yamim" — perat limchussar zeman, "tachat immo" — perat leyatom.

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: neemar kan "tachat hashshavet", veneemar lehallan "tachat immo". ma lehallan — perat lechol hashshemot hallalu, af kan — perat lechol hashshemot hallalu. uma kan — perat litrefa, af lehallan — perat litrefa.

"Hakkol", leetoye may? leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: harovea, vehannirba, vehammuketze, vehanneevad, vehaetnan, vehamechir, vetumetum, veanderoginos — kullan nichnasin laddir lehitasser. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: tumetum veanderoginos en nichnasin laddir lehitasser.
Vetanna didan, i gamar "tachat" "tachat" mikkodashim — hane name la, vei la yalef — hane mena leh?
Leolam gamayr, vehane rachamana rabbinhu, dichtiv: "ki moshchatam bahem mum bam lo yeratzu lachem", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: kol makom shenneemar bo hashechata, eno ella devar erva vaavoda zara.
Devar erva — dichtiv: "ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz", avoda zara — dichtiv: "pen tashchitun vaasitem lachem pesel temunat kol samel tavnit zachar o nekeva".

Vechol shehammum posel bo — devar erva vaavoda zara poslin bo, vechol sheen hammum posel bo — en devar erva vaavoda zara poslin bo, vehay maaser hoil vela pasel beh muma, dichtiv: "lo yevakker ben tov lara velo yemirennu" — devar erva vaavoda zara name la pasel beh.
Rovea venirba — devar erva, muketze veneevad — avoda zara, veetnan — devar erva, umechir ittakkash leetnan,
Tumetum veanderoginos — kasavar: sefeka hu.
Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer. kasavar sefeka hu, miet rachamana gabbe kadashim — zachar vadday unekeva vaddait, velo tumetum veanderoginos. maaser name gemar "tachat" "tachat" mikkodashim.

Tanu rabbanan: hakkol nichnasin laddir lehitasser, chutz min hakkilayim vehatterefa, divre rabbi elazar berabbi yehuda ish kefar bartota sheamar mishshum rabbi yehoshua. amar rabbi akiva: ani shamati hemennu af yotze dofen umechussar zeman veyatom.
Vetanna kamma, i gamar "tachat" "tachat" mikkodashim — hane name la, vei la gamar, bishlama terefa — "kol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet" ketiv, perat litrefa sheenah overet, ella kilayim mena leh?
Leolam gamar, uveyotze dofen —
b: Savar la kerabbi shimon, deamar: yotze dofen — valad mealleya hu, udela kerabbi yochanan.
Bimchussar zeman savar la kerabbi shimon ben yehuda, yatom — kegon shehashshelach kayyaym, verabbi yehoshua letameh, deamar: afillu shachat et immo vehashshelach kayyaym — en ze yatom.
Heid rabbi yishmael ben satriel mearkat livna lifne rabbi: bimkomenu mafshitin et hammeta umalbishin et hachay. amar rabbi: nitgalla tamah shel mishnatenu.
Chazerin shebbimkomenu yesh lahem shishshim ribbo kelafim bevet hemses shello, paam achat nafal erez echad shebbimkomenu, veavru shesh esre keronot al chuddo achat.
Paam achat nafla betzat bar yochani, vetibbea shishshim kerakkim, veshibbera shelosh meot arazim. umi shadya leh? veha ketiv: "kenaf renanim neelasa"! amar rav ashe: hahu muzarta havay.
Mishna shalosh goranot lemasar behema: bifras happesach, uvifras haatzeret, uvifras hechag, vehen goranot shel masar behema, divre rabbi akiva.

Ben azzay omer: beesrim vetisha baadar, beechad besivan, beesrim vetisha beav. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: beechad benisan, beechad besivan, beesrim vetisha beelul. velama amru beesrim vetisha beelul velo amru beechad betishri? mippene shehu yom tov, vei efshar leasser beyom tov — lefichach hikdimuhu beesrim vetisha beelul.
Rabbi meir omer: beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema. ben azzay omer: haelulim mitasserim bifne atzman.

Kol hannoladim meechad betishri ad esrim vetisha beelul — hare ellu mitztarfin. chamishsha lifne rosh hashshana vachamishsha leachar rosh hashshana — enan mitztarfin. chamishsha lifne haggoren vachamishsha leachar haggoren — hare ellu mitztarfin. im ken, lamma neemru shalosh goranot lemasar behema? shead shello higgia haggoren — muttar limkor velishchot, higgia haggoren — lo yishchot, veim shachat — patur.
Gemara may shena telat? amar rabba bar shela: lokovel churefe, veafle, vekayyte.
Umay shena behane zimne? amar rabbi tanchum bereh derav chiyyay ish kefar akko:

a: Kede shettehe behema metzuya leole regalim.
Veaf al gav ditnan: ad shello higgia haggoren muttar limkor velishchot — nicha leh delitavid mitzva bemamoneh, vahadar lizbon velechol.
Veammay kare leh "goren"? detavla kegoren.
Vechamma "peras"? peresh rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: en peras pachot mechamishsha asar yom.

May mashma? amar rabbi avahu: "peros" — palga. palga demay? palga dehilchot pesach, ki ha detanya: shoalin vedorshin behilchot pesach kodem lefesach sheloshim yom. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shete shabbatot.

Ben azzay omer: beesrim vetisha baadar, beechad besivan. bemay kamippalgi rabbi akiva uven azzay? rabbi akiva savar: adar hassamuch lenisan zimnin male vezimnin chaser, zimnin demikkela beyom sheloshim vezimnin demikkela beesrim vetisha, umishshum hachi la kevia leh zeman. uven azzay savar: adar hassamuch lenisan leolam chaser, hilkach kevia leh zeman beesrim vetisha baadar.
Beechad besivan — ayyeyde dela nefishi, i amrat likaddem liassar — ad demate regel shalmi lehu.
Beesrim vetisha beav vechulei. ben azzay letameh, deamar: haelulin mitasserin bifne atzman.
Veliasserinhu beyom sheloshim! zimnin dimchasserin leh leav, uvaenan lemibad hekkera bechadash veyashan.
Rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: beechad benisan, beechad besivan vechulei. beechad benisan — kerabban shimon ben gamliel, deamar: shete shabbatot. beechad besivan — kedaamaran.
Beesrim vetisha beelul — rabbi elazar verabbi shimon letamayyhu, deamri: beechad betishri rosh hashshana lemasar behema.
Velama amru beesrim vetisha beelul, velo amru beechad betishri? mippene shehu yom tov vechulei. vetippok leh, devaenan lemebad hekkera bechadash veyashan!
Chada veod kaamar, chada — devaenan lemibad hekkera bechadash veyashan, veod — mippene shehu yom tov, vei efshar leasser beyom tov mishshum sekarta.
Rabbi meir omer: beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema. ben azzay omer vechulei. tanya, amar ben azzay: hoil vehallalu omrim kach, vehallalu omrim kach — haelulin mitasserin leatzman.
Velichze tameh deman mistabbar! vechi tema: la matze kae attamayyhu, vehatanya: ben azzay omer: kol chachme yisrael domin alay kiklippat hashshum chutz min hakkereach hazze!
Amar rabbi yochanan: mippi hashshemua amaruha, mippi chaggay zecharya umalachi.

Tanya: beeze tzad amar ben azzay haelulim mitasserin leatzman? noldu lo chamishsha beav vachamishsha beelul — en mitztarfin, chamishsha beelul vachamishsha betishri — en mitztarfin, chamishsha betishri vachamishsha beav mitztarfin.
Peshita! mahu detema, ki hechi demafseki shanim, mafseki goranot, ka mashma lan.
Keditnan: chamishsha lifne rosh hashshana vachamishsha leachar rosh hashshana — en mitztarfin, chamishsha lifne haggoren vachamishsha leachar haggoren — hare ellu mitztarfin.
Amar rava: ledivre ben azzay, noldu lo chamishsha beav vachamishsha beelul vachamishsha betishri, konsan laddir lehitasser,
b: Venotel echad min haelulin vehashshear peturin, mimma nafshach: i beechad beelul rosh hashshana — deelul vetishri mitztarfin udeav peturim, vei beechad betishri rosh hashshana — deav veelul mitztarfin detishri peturin.
May amrat: litztarfu legoren acher? asiri vadday amar rachamana, velo safek.
Peshita! mahu detema ligzor, dilma ate lemishkal mehanach, ka mashma lan.

Mishna bee ze tzad measserin? konsan laddir, veose lahem petach katan kede shello yehu shenayim yecholin latzet keechat, umonin: echad, shenayim, shelosha, arbaa, chamishsha, shishsha, shiva, shemona, tisha, vehayyotze asiri soker besikra veomer: "hare ze maaser". lo sekaro besikra, velo menaan bashshevet, o shemmenaan revutzim o omdim — hare ellu mitasserin.

Haya lo mea venatal asara, asara venatal echad — en ze maaser. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: maaser. kafatz echad min hammenuyin letochan — hare ellu peturin, min hameussarin letochan — kullam yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyeachlu bemuman labbealim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: bee ze tzad measser? konsan laddir, veose lahem petach katan kede shello yehu shenayim yecholin latzet keechad, immotehem mibbachutz vehem mibbifnim, vegoot, veyotzot likrat imman.
Velappekinhu inhu! "yaavor" ketiv, velo sheyyaaviruhu.
Velishde lehu yarka velippeku levateh! amar rav huna: gezera mishshum lakuach umishshum yatom.

Tanu rabbanan: "kol asher yaavor tachat" — perat latterefa sheenah overet tachat hashshavet. mitzva limnotan beshevet. lo menaan beshevet, o shemmenaan revutzim o omdim, minnayin? talmud lomar: "haasiri kodesh" — mikkol makom.

Veen li ella shekkera shemo "asiri", lo kera shemo "asiri" minnayin? talmud lomar "yihye kodesh" mikkol makom. yachol hayu lo mea venatal asara, asara venatal echad, yachol yihyu meussarin? talmud lomar "asiri", veen ze asiri. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: maaser.

May tameh derabbi yose berabbi yehuda? savar leh keabba elazar ben gomel, detanya: abba elazar ben gomel omer: "venechshav lachem terumatchem" — bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber, achat teruma gedola, veachat terumat maaser.
Keshem shehatteruma gedola nittelet beomed uvemachshava —

a: Af terumat maaser nittelet beomed uvemachshava, umaaser karyeh rachamana teruma, dichtiv: "ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu laAdonai teruma natatti lalviyyim lenachala", veittakkash masar behema lemaaser dagan, ma masar dagan nittal beomed uvemachshava — af masar behema nittal beomed uvemachshava.
Amar rava: asiri meelav hu kadosh. mena leh lerava ha? illema meha detanya: en li ella shekkara shemo "asiri", lo kara shemo "asiri" minnayin? talmud lomar: "asiri yihye kodesh" — mikkol makom.
Vedilma "asiri" hu dela karyeh, "kodesh" karyeh! ella meha detanya: kara latteshii "asiri", veyatza haasiri velo dibber — hatteshii neechol bemumo, vehaasiri maaser.
Vedilma shane hatam, deibbarar leh asiri, i name, deachvi illaveh!
Ella meha detanya: kara latteshii "asiri", umet asiri baddir — teshii neechol bemumo, vechullam peturin. may tama kullam peturin, lav mishshum dikdash leh asiri?
Vedilma deippetaru beminyan harauy, dehaamar rava: minyan harauy poter!
Ella meha detanya: kara latteshii "asiri", venishtayyer asiri baddir — hatteshii neechol bemumo, vehaasiri maaser. vehatanya: teshii chullin!
Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet: ha manni? rabbi shimon ben yehuda hi, detanya: rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon:
b: Af hatteshii eno kadosh ella im ken neekar shem asiri hemennu, vehaddin noten.
Uma achad asar shehu ose kedushsha likrav, eno kadosh ella im ken neekar shem "asiri" hemennu, teshii sheen ose kedushsha likrav — eno din sheim neekar shem "asiri" hemennu — in, i la — la?
Hi hannotenet! achad asar shehu ose kedushsha likrav, i neekar shem asiri hemennu — in, i la — la; teshii sheeno ose kedushsha likrav, af al gav dela neekar shem asiri hemennu.
I name, achad asar, deibbarar leh asiri — i neekar shem asiri hemennu — in, i la — la.
Teshii, deakkatti la ibbarar leh asiri, veaf al gav dela neekar shem "asiri" hemennu, tu la middi.
Amar rava: minyan harauy poter. mena leh lerava ha? illema meha ditnan: kafatz echad min hammenuyin letochan — kullan peturin. menuyin gufayyhu deippetaru — lav beminyan harauy?
Vedilma deassar illavayyhu!
Hahi la matzet amrat, ha tane: min hameussarin letochan!
Vedilma may "meussarin"? maaser davka, dayka name dekatane "yiru"!
Ella amar rava: amar kera "yaavor", velo shekkevar avar. may shekkevar avar? i deassar illavayyhu — tzericha lememra? ella lav deippetaru lehu beminyan harauy? shema minna.

Tanya kevavteh derava: hayu lo asara telaim vehichnisan laddir, umane chamishsha, umet echad mehem — im min hammenuyim met — mone umashlim alehem, veim mishsheenan menuyim met — menuyim peturin, vesheenan menuyim mitztarfin laggoren acher.

Veamar rava: hayu lo arbaa asar telaim vehichnisan ledir, veyatzu shishsha befetach ze, vearbaa befetach ze, vearbaa nishtayyeyru sham. otam arbaa, im befetach hashshishsha yatzu — notel echad mehem, vehashshear mitztarfin legoren acher;
Veim lav — shishsha peturin, vearbaa arbea mitztarfin legoren acher.

Yatzu arbaa befetach ze, veshishsha befetach ze, venishtayyeyru sham arbaa — im otam arbaa befetach hashshishsha yatzu — notel mehem echad, vehashshear peturim; veim lav — arbaa veshishsha peturim, vearbaa mitztarfin legoren acher.

Yatzu arbaa befetach ze, vearbaa befetach ze, venishtayyeyru sham shishsha — im otan shishsha yatzu befetach echad — notel mehem echad vehashshear peturim; veim lav — arbaa peturim, veshishsha mitztarfin legoren acher.
May ka mashma lan, deminyan harauy poter? vehaamra rava chada zimna! mahu detema: vadday minyan harauy amrinan, sefek minyan harauy, dachaze lehacha vedachaze lehacha — la amrinan, ka mashma lan.

Veamar rava: hayu lo chamishsha asar telaim, lo yomar: evror asara veachnisem laddir veettol mehem echad, vehashshear peturim, ella konsan laddir, umotzi asara, venotel mehem echad, vehashshear mitztarfin legoren acher. tanya name hachi: hayu lo chamishsha asar telaim,

a: Lo yomar: evror asara veettol mehen echad vehashshear peturim, ella konsan laddir, umotzi asara, venotel mehen echad, vehashshear mitztarfin legoren acher.
Vehatanya: tisha asar telaim, lo yomar: evror asara veettol mehen echad, vehashshear peturin, ella konsan laddir, umotzi asara venotel mehen echad, vehashshear peturin.
Targema rav huna bar sechora kammeh derava berigla: bedir sheyyesh lo shene fetachim askinan, veyatzu tisha befetach ze vetisha befetach ze, dehaych chad chaze lehacha ulehacha.
Velishanne leh: kegon shemmana tisha, vechi meta asara kare "chad" meresha! kasavar: asiri meelav kadosh.
Velishanne leh begoren, umenaan zugot zugot! kasavar: asiri leminyan behemot hu kadosh.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: zechay immeh derav huna bar sechora, deshanni leh shemata berigla kishmateh.
Mishna yatzu shenayim keachat — mone otam shenayim shenayim, menaan echad — teshii vaasiri mekulekalin.
Kara latteshii "asiri", velaasiri "teshii", velaachad asar "asiri" — shelashtan mekuddashin: hatteshii neechol bemumo, vehaasiri maaser, veachad asar karev shelamim veose temura, divre rabbi meir.

Amar rabbi yehuda: vechi yesh temura osa temura? amru mishshum rabbi meir: illu haya temura — lo haya karev. kara latteshii "asiri", velaasiri "asiri", velaachad asar "asiri" — en achad asar mekuddash. ze hakkelal: kol shello neekar shem asiri mimmennu, en achad asar mekuddash.
Gemara amar rabbi yochanan: menaan zugot zugot, kintarin kintarin — asiri leminyano hu kadosh.
"Leminyano" may? rav mari amar: lamminyan shello hu kadosh, rav kahana amar: leminyan behemot hu kadosh.
Tenan: yatzu shenayim keachat — mone otan shenayim shenayim. menaan echad — teshii vaasiri mekulekalin.

Bishlama leman deamar: lamminyan shello hu kadosh, mishshum hachi havu teshii vaasiri mekulekalin, velaasiri ka kare leh "teshii", velaachad asar "asiri". ella leman deamar: leminyan behemot hu kadosh, latteshii "teshii" ka kare leh, velaasiri "asiri" ka kare leh!
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: ki amena ana — hechi deikkavven leappoke zugot zugot, hecha dinfak mimmela — la.
Ta shema: menaan lemafrea — asiri shebbeminyan hu kadosh. bishlama leman deamar leminyan behemot hu kadosh — shappir, ella leman deamar lamminyan shello hu kadosh, asiri "chad" kare leh!
Amar rava: hoil veiteh beminyana parsaa, dekaru leasra "chad".
b: Kara latteshii "asiri", velaasiri "teshii", velaachad asar "asiri". tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheim kara latteshii "asiri", velaasiri "teshii", velaachad asar "asiri", sheshshelashtan mekuddashin?
Talmud lomar: "vechol masar bakar vatzon kol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet haasiri yihye kodesh", yachol sheani merabbe af shemini ushenem asar?
Amrat: hoil vehu kadosh, vetauto mitkaddeshet, ma hu eno mekuddash ella besamuch, af tauto enah mitkaddeshet ella besamuch.
Vehatanya: ma hu meyuchad, af tauto meyuchedet!

Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan: ha manni? rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi, detanya: rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: leolam en achad asar kadosh ad sheyyishtok batteshii, veyikra laasiri "teshii", velaachad asar "asiri".
Savar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: taut maaser temura have, vesavar la kaavu, deamar: en memer chozer umemer.
Amar rava: yatzu shenayim batteshii, keraan "teshii" — asiri vechullin meoravin ze baze, asiri meelav kadosh, latteshii "teshii" ka kare leh.
Keraan "asiri", asiri uteshii meoravin ze baze. may tama? "asiri" ka kare lehu letarvayyhu.
Yatzu shenayim baasiri ukeraan "asiri", asiri veachad asar meoravin ze baze. keraan "achad asar", asiri vechullin meoravin ze baze.
Ha tu lema li? hayeynu hach! ha ka mashma lan: dechol bat achat tarvavyyhu ka kadshi, veaf al gav delo neekar shem "asiri" hemennu.

Yatev rav kahana vekaamar leh leha shemata, amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: vahalo lo neekar shem "asiri" hemennu, utenan ze hakkelal: kol zeman shello neekar shem "asiri" hemennu — en achad asar mekuddash! hane mille beze achar ze, aval bevat achat — tarvayyhu ka kadshi.
Ze achar ze — behedya katane la: kara latteshii "asiri", velaasiri "asiri", velaachad asar "asiri" — en achad asar mekuddash. "ze hakkelal" leetoye may? lav leetoye bevat achat?
La, leetoye yatza asiri velo dibber, deha lo neekar shem "asiri" hemennu.

Dei la tema hachi, ha detanya: yatzu shenayim baasiri, velo kadam echad mehen et chavero, ukeraan "asiri" — asiri veachad asar meoravin ze baze, vahalo lo neekar shem asiri hemennu! ella lav mishshum deamrinan: kol bevat achat tarvayyhu ka kadshi.
I mishshum ha la irya, hacha bemay askinan? dikdem chad minnayyhu veappek leresheh, vekaryeh "achad asar", vahadar iaruv unefuk bahadade, ukerinhu "asiri", deha neekar shem asiri hemennu.
Veha "lo kadam" katane! may "lo kadam"? dahadar iaruv.
Ucheman? dela kerabbi, dei rabbi — haamar: "achad asar" la have akira!
Afillu tema rabbi, ki amar rabbi hecha deit leh behemot tuva, deamrinan: chad issura kaamar, hacha delet leh behemot tefe.

May rabbi? detanya: kara laasiri "achad asar", velaachad asar "asiri" — en achad asar kadosh, divre rabbi. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: achad asar kadosh. kelal amar rabbi: kol zeman shello neekar shem asiri hemennu — en achad asar kadosh. amar rava: hacha bemay askinan? kegon deit leh behemot tuva, deamrinan: chad issura kaamar.
Yatzu shenayim baasiri, tane chada: yiru, vetanya iddach: yikreyvu, vetanya iddach: yamutu.
La kashya, ha detanya yiru — rabbanan hi, deamri: en meviin kadashim levet happesul"

a: Veha detane yikreyvu — rabbi shimon hi, deamar: meviin kadashim levet happesul.
Veha detane yamutu — rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: taut maaser, temura havya, kasavar rabbi yehuda: temurat maaser meta.
Vekasavar rabbi yehuda temurat maaser meta? vehatnan, amru mishshum rabbi meir: illu haya temura lo haya karev, mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar karev!

Vechi tema: rabbi meir lemay disvira leh kaamar, vehatanya: en ben achad asar lishlamim, ella shezze ose kedushsha likrav, veze en ose kedushsha likrav, divre rabbi yehuda. kadosh likrav hu dela hu aved, ha ihu gufeh karev!
Veod, detanya: "im min habbakar" — lerabbot achad asar lishlamim.
Yachol sheani merabbe af hatteshii? amarta: vechi hekdesh lefanav mekaddesh o leacharav mekaddesh? heve omer — leacharav mekaddesh.
Setam sifra manni? rabbi yehuda, vekatane: "min habbakar" — lerabbot achad asar lishlamim.
Ella targema rabbi shimon berabbi abba kammeh derabbi yochanan: bemaaser bizman hazze askinan, umishshum takkala.
I hachi, may irya tere? afillu chad name! la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya chad delet leh peseda, aval tere, kevan dinfishi peseda — lishahinhu ad denippol behu muma velechlinhu, ka mashma lan.

Ittemar: haomer lishlucho "tze veasser alay", rav pappi mishshemeh derava amar: kara latteshii "asiri" — kadosh, velaachad asar "asiri" — eno kadosh. verav pappa amar: afillu kara latteshii "asiri" — eno kadosh, deamar leh: letakkone shaddartaycha vela leauote.
Umay shena meha ditnan: haomer lishlucho "tze uterom" — torem kedaat baal habbayit.
Im eno yodea dato shel baal habbayit — torem bevenonit, echad mechamishshim. pichet asara o hosif asara — terumato teruma?
Amri: hatam, kevan deikka detarem beayin yafa, veikka detarem beayin raa, amar: lehachi amadtich. hacha tauta hi, amar: la ibbei lach lemite.
Hadaran alach masar behema, uselika la massechet bechorot.
Mishna hakkol maarichin, veneerachin, nodrin veniddarin — kohanim, lovim veyisreelim, nashim vaavadim.
Tumetum veanderoginos, nodrin veniddarin umaarichin, aval lo neerachin, sheeno neerach ella hazzachar vadday unekeva vaddait.
Cheresh shote vekatan niddarin veneerachin, aval lo nodrin velo maarichin, mippene sheen bahem daat.
Gemara "hakkol maarichin" — leetoye may? leetoye mufela samuch leish.
"Neerachin" — leetoye may? leetoye menvvavl umukke shechin.
Salka datach amena: "neder beerkecha" ketiv, kol sheyyeshno bedamim — yeshno baarachin, vechol sheeno bedamim — eno baarachin.
Ka mashma lan "nefashot", kol dehu.
"Nodrin" — leetoye may? niddarin itzterich leh.
"Niddarin" — leetoye may? i leetoye tumetum veanderoginos — behedya katane lehu! vei leetoye cheresh shote vekatan — behedya katane lehu!
I leetoye pachot mibben chodesh, behedya katane lehu! vei leetoye nachri, behedya katane lehu! leolam leetoye pachot mibben chodesh, vetane vahadar mefaresh.
"Hakkol somchin" — leetoye may? leetoye yoresh, udela kerabbi yehuda.
"Hakkol memirin" — leetoye may? leetoye yoresh, udela kerabbi yehuda.
Detanya: yoresh somech, yoresh memer. rabbi yehuda omer: yoresh eno somech, yoresh eno memer.
May tama derabbi yehuda? "korbano" velo korban aviv, veyalef techillat hekdesh missof hekdesh — ma sof hekdesh yoresh eno somech, af techillat hekdesh yoresh eno memer.
Verabbanan, hamer yamir — lerabbot et hayyoresh, veyalfinan sof hekdesh mittechillat hekdesh: ma techillat hekdesh — yoresh memer, af sof hekdesh — yoresh somech.
Verabbanan, hay "korbano" may avdi leh? mibbee leh: "korbano" — velo korban goy, "korbano" — velo korban chavero, "korbano" — lerabbot kol baale chovrin lismicha.
Verabbi yehuda, lerabbot kol baale chovrin lismicha let leh, vei name it leh,
b: Goy vachavero mechad kera nafki, iyyaytari lehu tere: chad "korbano" velo korban aviv, veiddach lerabbot kol baale chovrin lismicha.

Verabbi yehuda, hay "hamer yamir" may aved leh? mibbee leh lerabbot et haishsha, detanya: lefi shekkol hainyan eno medabber ella bilshon zachar, ma sofenu lerabbot et haishsha? talmud lomar "veim hamer yamir".
Verabbanan? mivveim", verabbi yehuda "veim" la daresh.
"Hakkol chayyayvin besukka" — leetoye may? leetoye katan sheeno tzarich leimmo, ditnan: katan sheeno tzarich leimmo chayyayv besukka.
"Hakkol chayyayvin belulav" — leetoye may? leetoye katan hayyodea lenanea, ditnan: katan hayyodea lenanea chayyayv belulav.
"Hakkol chayyayvin betzitzit" — leetoye may? leetoye katan hayyodea lehitattef, detanya: katan hayyodea lehitattef — chayyayv betzitzit.
"Hakkol chayyayvin bitfillin" — leetoye may? leetoye katan hayyodea lishmor tefillin, detanya: katan hayyodea lishmor tefillin — aviv lokeach lo tefillin.
"Hakkol chayyayvin biriyyay" — leetoye may? leetoye mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin.
Uleravina deamar: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin patur min hariyyay, leetoye chigger beyom rishon venitpashshet beyom sheni.
Hanicha leman deamar: kullan tashlumin ze laze, ella leman deamar: kullan tashlumin larishon — leetoye may?
Leetoye suma beachat meenav, udela ki hay tanna.

Detanya, yochanan ben dahavay omer mishshum rabbi yehuda: suma beachat meenav patur min hariyyay, shenneemar: "yire" "yerae", kederech shebba lirot kach ba leraot, ma lirot bishte enav — af leraot bishte enav.
Veibbaet ema: leolam leetoye mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin, udeka kashya lach deravina — la kashya: kan bemishna rishona, kan bemishna acharona.
Ditnan: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin, oved et rabbo yom echad, veet atzmo yom echad, divre bet hillel.

Amru lahem bet shammay: tikkantem et rabbo, veet atzmo lo tikkantem? lissa shifcha eno yachol, bat chorin eno yachol, yibbatel? vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya ureviyya, shenneemar: "lo tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah"!
Ella, mippene tikkun haolam, kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin, vechotev shetar al chatzi damav, vechazru bet hillel lehorot kedivre bet shammay.
"Hakkol chayyayvin bitkiat shofar" — leetoye may? leetoye katan shehiggia lechinnuch, ditnan: en meakkevin et hakkatan millitkoa beyom tov.
"Hakkol chayyayvin bemikra megilla", "hakkol kesherin likrot et hammegilla" — leetoye

a: May? leetoye nashim, vechidrabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nashim chayyayvot bemikra megilla, sheaf hen hayu beoto hannes.
"Hakkol chayyayvin bezimmun" — leetoye may? leetoye nashim vaavadim, detanya: nashim mezammenot leatzman, vaavadim mezammenin leatzman.
"Hakkol mitztarfin lezimmun" — leetoye may? leetoye katan hayyodea lemi mevarchin, deamar rav nachman: yodea lemi mevarchin — mezammenin alav.
"Hakkol mittammein beziva" — leetoye may? leetoye tinok ben yomo, detanya: "ish" — ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? lerabbot tinok ben yom echad shemtamme beziva, divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "vehazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva", "lazzachar" — kol shehu zachar, ben katan ben gadol, "lannekeva" — kol shehi nekeva, ben ketanna ben gedola. im ken, ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.
"Hakkol mittammein bitme met" — leetoye may? leetoye katan; salka datach amena: "ish asher yitma velo yitchatta" — "ish" in, katan la, ka mashma lan: "veal hannefashot asher hayu sham".
Ella, "ish" lemaote may? lemaote katan mikkaret.
"Hakkol mittammein bingaim" — leetoye may? leetoye katan. salka datach amena: "ish tzarua" ketiv — ish in, katan la, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! adam "ki yihye veor besaro", mikkol makom.
Veella "ish" lema li? lechidtanya: "ish" — en li ella ish, ishsha minnayin? keshehu omer "vehatztzarua" — hare kan shenayim.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "ish"? lainyan shel matta — ish porea uforem, veen haishsha poraat uforemet.
"Hakkol roin et hannegaim", "hakkol kesherin lirot et hannegaim" — leetoye may? leetoye sheeno baki bahen uvishmotehen.
Vehaamar mar: eno baki bahen uvishmotehen — eno roe et hannegaim! amar ravina: la kashya, ha demasberi leh vesavar, ha demasberi leh vela savar.

"Hakkol kesherin lekaddesh" — leetoye may? lerabbi yehuda leetoye katan, ulerabbanan leetoye ishsha. ditnan: hakkol kesherin lekaddesh, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan; rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan, ufosel beishsha uveanderoginos.
"Hakkol kesherin lehazzot" — leetoye may? leetoye arel, vechidrabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: arel shehizza — hazzaato keshera.
"Hakkol shochatin" — leetoye may? chada leetoye kuti, vachada leetoye yisrael meshummad.
"Hakkol maalin leeretz yisrael" — leetoye may?
b: Leetoye avadim, uleman detane avadim behedya, leetoye may? leetoye minnave hayyafa lenave haraa.
"Veen hakkol motziin" — leetoye eved shebbarach mechutza laaretz laaretz.
"Hakkol maalin lirushalayim" — leetoye minnave hayyafa lenave haraa, "veen hakkol motziin" — leetoye may? leetoye minnave haraa lenave hayyafa.
Hakkol chayyayvin besukka, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita! i hane la michayyeyvi, man michayyeyvi?

Kohanim itztericha leh, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "bassukkot teshvu", veamar mar "teshvu shivat yamim" keen taduru, ma dira — ish veishto, af sukka — ish veishto, vehane kohanim hoil uvene avoda ninhu — la lichayyeyvu.
Ka mashma lan: nehi diftiri bishat avoda, belo sheat avoda chayyove michayyeyvi, midde dehave aholche derachim, deamar mar: holche derachim bayyom peturin min hassukka bayyom, vechayyayvim ballayla.
Hakkol chayyayvin betzitzit, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita!

Kohanim itzterich leh, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "lo tilbash shaatnez... gedilim taase lach", man dela ishteri kilayim legabbeh bilvisha hu dimchayyayv bemitzvat tzitzit, vehane kohanim, hoil veishteri kilayim legabbayyhu, la lichayyeyvu.
Ka mashma lan: nehi deishteri beiddan avoda, bela iddan avoda la ishteri.

Hakkol chayyayvin bitfillin, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita! kohanim itzterich leh, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "ukeshartam leot al yadecha vehayu letotafot ben enecha", kol deiteh bemitzva deyad iteh bemitzva derosh.
Vehane kohanim, hoil veletanhu bemitzva deyad, dichtiv "yilbash al besaro", shello yehe davar chotzetz beno uven besaro, ema bemitzva derosh name la lichayyeyvu.
Ka mashma lan dela meakkevi ahadade, keditnan: tefilla shel yad enah meakkevet shel rosh, veshel rosh enah meakkevet shel yad.
Umay shena deyad, dichtiv "yilbash al besaro"? rosh name, ketiv "vesamta hammitznefet al rosho"!
Tana: searo haya nire ben tzitz lemitznefet, sheshsham manniach tefillin.

Hakkol chayyayvin bitkiat shofar, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita! kohanim itztericha leh, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "yom terua yihye lachem", man deleteh ella bitkia dechad yoma chayyayv.
Vehane kohanim, hoil veitanhu bitkia kullay shatta, dichtiv: "utekatem bachatzotzrot al olotechem", ema la lichayyeyvu. mi dame? hatam chatzotzrot, hacha shofar!

Itzterich, salka datach amena, hoil utenan: shave hayyovel lerosh hashshana lattekia velabberachot, deiteh bemitzvat yovel — iteh bemitzvat rosh hashshana, deleteh bemitzvat yovel — leteh bemitzvat rosh hashshana, vehane kahane hoil veletanhu bemitzvat deyovel, ditnan: kohanim uleviyyim mochrin leolam

a: Vegoalin leolam, ema bemitzvat rosh hashshana name la lichayyeyvu, kamashma lan: nehi deletanhu behashematat karka behashematat kesafim — beshilluach avadim miha itanhu.

Hakkol chayyayvim bemikra megilla, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita! la tzericha livattel avodatam, vechidrav yehuda amar shemuel, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kohanim baavodatam, uleviyyim beduchanan, veyisrael bemaamadan — mevattelin avodatam uvain lishmoa mikra megilla.
Hakkol chayyayvin bezimmun, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita! la tzericha, dekaachli kodashim. salka datach amena: "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem" amar rachamana, veha kappara hi.
Ka mashma lan, "veachalta vesavata" amar rachamana, veha itanhu.
Hakkol mitztarfin lezimmun, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita! la tzericha, dekaachli kohanim teruma o kodashim, vezar kaachel chullin.
Salka datach amena: hoil vei bae zar lemechal bahade kohen la matze achel, ema la litztaref, ka mashma lan: nehi dezar bahade kohen la matze achel, kohen bahade zar matze achel.
Hakkol maarichin, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita! amar rava: lo nitzrecha ella leven bucheri, ditnan: amar rabbi yehuda, heid ben bucheri beyavne: kol kohen sheshshokel eno chote.
Amar lo rabban yochanan ben zakkay: lo ken, ella kol kohen sheeno shokel chote, ella shehakkohanim dorshin mikra ze leatzman: "vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel".
Hoil veomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim shellanu hem, heach hem neechalin?
Uleven bucheri name, kevan dilchattechilla la michayyeyvi leetoye, ki mayyte name — chote hu, deka meayyel chullin laazara! demayyte lehu umasar latztzibbur.
Salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh", kol deiteh bishkalim — iteh baarachin, vehane kohanim, hoil veletanhu bishkalim — letanhu baarachin, ka mashma lan.
Amar leh abbaye: hay "vechol erkecha", lechol arachin sheatta maarich lo yehu pechutin missela hu daata!

Ella amar abbaye: itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde beerkecha", kol deiteh befidyon habben — iteh baarachin, vehane kohanim hoil veletanhu befidyon habben — letanhu baarachin, ka mashma lan.

Amar leh rava: ella meatta, gabbe el asham, dichtiv: "veet ashamo yavi laAdonai ayil tamim min hatztzon beerkecha", hachi name dechol deiteh baarachin iteh beel haasham, tumetum veanderoginos deletanhu baarachin letanhu beel haasham?
Ella amar rava, veittema rav ashe: itzterich, salka datach amena, hoil uchetiv "veheemido lifne hakkohen", velo kohen lifne kohen, ka mashma lan.
"Neerachin" — leetoye menvvavl umukke shechin. mena hane mille?
Detanu rabbanan: "beerkecha" — lehavi erech satum. davar acher: "beerkecha" — erech kullo hu noten, velo erech evarim.
Yachol sheani motzi af davar shehanneshama teluya bo? talmud lomar "nefashot", nefashot — velo hammet.
Otzi et hammet, velo otzi et haggoses? talmud lomar: "veheemid... veheerich" — kol sheyyeshno behaamada, yeshno behaaracha, vechol sheeno behaamada, eno behaaracha.
Davar acher: "nefashot", en li ella echad sheheerich echad, echad sheheerich mea minnayin? talmud lomar "nefashot". davar acher: "nefashot",
b: En li ella ish sheheerich ben ish ben ishsha, ishsha sheheericha ish, ishsha sheheericha ishsha minnayin? talmud lomar "nefashot".
Davar acher: "nefashot" — lerabbot menvvavl umukke shechin.
Sheyyachol "neder beerkecha": kol sheyyeshno bedamim — yeshno baarachin, vechol sheeno bedamim — eno baarachin, talmud lomar "nefashot".

"Vehaya erkecha" — lerabbot tumetum veanderoginos ledamim, sheyyachol: neder "beerkecha" — kol sheyyeshno baarachin yeshno bedamim, vechol sheeno baarachin eno bedamim, talmud lomar: "vehaya erkecha".

"Hazzachar" — zachar, velo tumetum veanderoginos. yachol lo yehu beerech ish, aval yihyu beerech ishsha? talmud lomar: "vehaya erkecha hazzachar... veim nekeva hi" — zachar vadday, nekeva vaddait, velo tumetum veanderoginos.
Amar mar: "beerkecha" — lerabbot erech satum. may erech satum?
Detanya: haomer "erech satum alay" noten kappachot shebbaarachin, vechamma pachot shebbaarachin? sheloshet shekalim.
Veema chamishshim! tafasta merubbe — lo tafasta, tafasta muat — tafasta.
Veema shekel, dichtiv: "vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh"! hahu behesseg yad hu dichtiv.
Veella kara lema li? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lomar sheeno niddon behesseg yad. may tama? kimfaresh dame.
Ikka deamri, amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: niddon behesseg yad. peshita! mahu detema kimfaresh dame, kamashma lan.
Davar acher: "beerkecha" — erech kullo hu noten, veeno noten erech deme evarim. veha appekteh leerech setam? keri beh "erech" "beerkecha".
Yachol sheani motzi davar shehanneshama teluya bo, talmud lomar: "nefashot", "nefashot" — velo et hammet.
Veha appekteh! keri beh "nefesh", "nefashot".
Otzi et hammet, velo otzi et haggoses? talmud lomar: "vehaamid veheerich".
I hachi, met name tippok li mivveheemid veheerich"? hachi name! veella, "nefesh" "nefashot" lema li? kidvaenan lememar kamman.
Davar acher, "nefashot" — en li ella echad sheheerich echad, echad sheheerich mea minnayin? talmud lomar "nefashot".
Davar acher, "nefashot" — en li ella ish sheheerich, ben ish ben ishsha, ishsha sheheericha ish, veishsha sheheericha ishsha minnayin? talmud lomar: "nefashot".
Davar acher: "nefashot" — lehavi menvvavl umukke shechin. veha appekteh lehanach!
Hanach la tzerichi kera, may tama? ki shakul hu, veyavou kullam ki itzterich kera, limnvvavl umukke shechin hu deitzterich.
Vehaya erkecha — lerabbot tumetum veanderoginos ledamim. damim lema li kera? lo yehe ella deme dikla, illu amar "deme dikla" mi la yahev?
Amar rava: lomar shenniddon bichvodo.
Salka datach amena: "neder beerkecha" ketiv, kol sheyyeshno baarachin — niddon bichvodo, vechol sheeno baarachin — eno niddon bichvodo.

Amar leh abbaye: udela iteh baarachin, mi niddon bichvodo? vehatanya: "rosh eved ze hekdesh" hu vehekdesh shuttafin bo, "rosh eved machur lecha" meshammenin benehem, "rosh chamor ze hekdesh" hu vehekdesh shuttafin bo, "rosh chamor machur lach" meshammenin benehem.
"Rosh para machur lecha" — lo machar ella roshah shel para. velo od, ella afillu: "rosh para hekdesh" en lahekdesh ella roshah. veamar rav pappa: deha mizdabban resha detora beve tabbacha.
Veha chamor ufara letanhu baarachin, veen niddon bichvodo! velitamaych, tikshe lach eved, deiteh baarachin, veen niddon bichvodo!
Ella la kashya: ha bekodshe mizbeach, ha bekodshe bedek habbayit.
Bemay okemta, bekodshe mizbach? ema sefa: velo od, ella afillu amar "rosh para zo hekdesh" — en lahekdesh ella roshah. ammay? tifshot kedushsha bechulla! mi la tanya: haomer

a: "Raglah shel zo ola" — yachol tehe kullah ola? talmud lomar "kol asher yitten mimmennu laAdonai yihye kodesh" — mimmennu kodesh velo kullah kodesh.
Yachol tetze lechullin? talmud lomar: "yihye" — bahavayaytah tehe. ha ketzad? timmacher letzorche olot, vedameha chullin, chutz middeme oto ever shebbah, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: minnayin laomer "raglah shel zo ola", shekkullah ola? talmud lomar: "kol asher yitten mimmennu laAdonai yihye kodesh", lerabbot et kullah.
Vaafillu leman deamar en kullah ola, hane mille deakdesh davar sheen hanneshama teluya bo, aval davar shehanneshama teluya bo — kadsha kullah.
Ella, la kashya: ha bikdushshat hagguf, ha bikdushshat damim.
Veha mar hu deamar: makdish zachar ledamav — kadosh kedushshat hagguf!
La kashya: ha deakdesh kullah, ha deakdesh chad ever.
Chad ever name ibbeoye ibbaya lan, devae rabba: hikdish ever ledamav, mahu?
Ki ibbei lan betam, hacha bevaal mum, dumeya dachamor.
Baal mum name ibbeoye ibbaya lan, devae rabba: "deme roshi legabbe mizbeach" mahu? ki ibbaya lan mikkamme deeshmea leha matnita, hasheta deshama ha matnita — la mibbaya lan.
Gufa, bae rabba: "deme roshi legabbe mizbeach" mahu? niddon bichvodo, o eno niddon bichvodo?
La ashkechan bedamim deeno niddon bichvodo, o dilma la ashkechan legabbe mizbeach deniddon bichvodo? teku.
Bae rava: "erki alay legabbe mizbeach" mahu? niddon behesseg yad, o en niddon behesseg yad?
La ashkechan baarachin deen niddon behesseg yad, o dilma la ashkechan legabbe mizbeach demipperik ella beshovyo? teku.

Bae rav ashe: hikdish sede achuzza legabbe mizbeach, mahu? mi amrinan: la ashkechan sede achuzza demipparka ella "bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef", o dilma la ashkechan legabbe mizbeach demipperik ella beshovyo? teku.
Mishna pachot mibben chodesh niddar, aval lo neerach.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: hammaarich pachot mibben chodesh, rabbi meir omer: noten damav, vachachamim omrim: lo amar kelum.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi meir savar: en adam motzi devarav levattala, yodea sheen arachin lefachot mibben chodesh, vegamar veamar leshem damim; verabbanan savri: adam motzi devarav levattala.
Keman azla ha deamar rav giddel amar rav: haomer "erech keli alay" noten damim — kerabbi meir. peshita dichrabbi meir atya!
Mahu detema, afillu kerabbanan, hatam hu detae, savar: ki hechi deikka arachin leven chodesh, ikka name lefachot mibben chodesh.
Aval hacha delekka lemite, vadday adam yodea sheen erech lichli, vegamar veamar leshem damim, kamashma lan.
b: Ulerabbi meir lemay itzterich?

Mahu detema: tama derabbi meir hatam, degazar pachot mibben chodesh attu ben chodesh, aval hacha delekka lemigzar — ema la. ka mashma lan: tama derabbi meir deen adam motzi devarav levattala, la shena hacha vela shena hacha.
Keman azla ha deamar rabba bar yosef amar rav, veamri la amar rav yeva bar yose amar rav: hammakdish behemat chavero noten dameha? keman — kerabbi meir.
Ha amra rav chada zimna, deamar rav giddel amar rav: haomer "erech keli alay" noten damav! mahu detema hatam hu deyodea sheen erech lichli, vegamar veamar leshem damim.
Aval behema, devat mikdash hi, ikka lememar dehachi kaamar: i amena le lemara mezabben la nihali, tikdosh la mehasheta veakreva, aval deme la kaamar, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav ashe: vehu deamar "alay", aval amar "hare zo" — lo.
Mishna nachri — rabbi meir omer: neerach, aval lo maarich. rabbi yehuda omer: maarich, aval lo neerach. veze vaze modim shennodrin veniddarin.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: bene yisrael maarichin veen haggoyim maarichin.
Yachol lo yehu neerachin? talmud lomar: "ish", divre rabbi meir.
Amar rabbi meir: vechi meachar shemmikra echad merabbe umikra echad memaet, mippene ma ani omer neerach velo maarich?
Mippene sheribba hakkatuv banneerachin yoter mibbammaarichin, shehare cheresh shote vekatan neerach, aval lo maarichin.
Rabbi yehuda omer: bene yisrael neerachin veen haggoyim neerachin; yachol lo yehu maarichin? talmud lomar "ish".

Amar rabbi yehuda: vechi meachar shemmikra echad merabbe umikra echad memaet, mippene ma ani omer nachri maarich velo neerach? mippene sheribba hakkatuv bammaarichin yoter mibbannerachin, shehare tumetum veanderoginos maarichin aval lo neerachin.
Amar rava: hilcheteh derabbi meir mistabbera, tameh la mistabbera, tama derabbi yehuda mistabbera, hilcheteh la mistabbera.
Hilcheteh derabbi meir mistabbera, dichtiv: "lo lachem valanu livnot et bet elohenu", tameh la mistabbera, deka mayyte leh mecheresh shote vekatan, shane cheresh shote vekatan delav bene dea ninhu.
Tama derabbi yehuda mistabbera, deka mayyte leh mittumetum veanderoginos, deaf al gav divne dea ninhu maatinhu rachamana. hilcheteh la mistabbera, dichtiv: "lo lachem valanu livnot et bet elohenu".
Verabbi yehuda, hay "la lachem velanu" may aved leh? amar rav chisda amar avimi: veerko nignaz.
Ella meatta, lo yimalu bo, ditnan: chamesh chattaot hammetot, umaot haholchot leyam hammelach — lo nehenin velo moalin!
Allema tanya gabbe kodshe goyim: bamme devarim amurim — bekodshe mizbeach, aval bekodshe bedek habbayit moalin bahen?!
Ella amar rava: mishshum rifyon yadayim hu, dichtiv: "vayhi am haaretz merappin yede am yehuda umevahalim otam livnot".

a: Tana chada: goy shehitnaddev nedava levedek habbayit mekabbelim hemennu, vetanya iddach: en mekabbelin!
Amar rabbi ila amar rabbi yochanan: la kashya, ha — battechilla, ha — bassof.

Deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: bitchilla, afillu mayim umelach en mekabbelin mehem. bassof, davar hamesuyyaym en mekabbelin, davar sheeno mesuyyaym mekabbelin. hechi dame davar hamesuyyaym? amar rav yosef: kegon amma kalya orev.

Metiv rav yosef: "veiggeret el asaf shomer happardes asher lammelech vegomer". amar leh abbayye: shane malchuta dela hadra bay, deamar shemuel: i amar malchuta "akarna ture", akar ture vela hadar beh.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: goy shehifrish teruma mikkiryo, bodkin oto, i bedaat yisrael hifrishah — tinnaten lakkohen, veim lav — teuna geniza, chayyshinan shemma belibbo lashshamayim.
Metivi: goy shehitnaddev kora, veshem katuv aleha — bodkin oto, im amar: "bedaat yisrael hifrashtiha" — yagod veyishtammesh bammotar, veim lav — teuna geniza, chayyshinan shemma belibbo lashshamayim.
Tama deshem katuv aleha, devaaya geniza; ha en shem katuv aleha — la baaya geniza!
Hu haddin deaf al gav deen shem katuv aleha name baaya geniza, veha ka mashma lan, deaf al gav deshem katuv aleha, yagod veyishtammesh bammotar, deshem shello bimkomo lav kadosh.
Ditnan: haya katuv al yedot hakkelim veal kare hammitta — hare ze yagod veyignoz.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avahu: haomer "sela zo litzdaka" — muttar leshannotah. sevur minna: leatzmo — in, leacher — la. ittemar: amar rav amme amar rabbi yochanan: ben leatzmo ben leacher.
Amar rabbi zeera: lo shanu ella deamar "alay", aval amar "hare zo" — beena bae lemitteva.
Matkef la rava: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera — amar "zo" mishtammesh bah, ki hechi delichayyayv beachrayuta, aval amar "alay" — la! ella, la shena.
Tanya kevavteh derava: neder tzedaka, veen hekdesh tzedaka. may kaamar? la neder vela hekdesh tzedaka!
Ella lav hachi kaamar: tzedaka hare hi beval teacher, veenah kehekdesh, deillu hekdesh asir leishtammoshe beh, veillu tzedaka shere leishtammoshe beh.

Amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea, amar: attun hachi matnitu la, anan hachi matnenan la — amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: haomer "sela zo litzdaka" muttar leshannotah, ben leatzmo ben leacher, ben amar "alay" ben amar "hare zo".
Tanu rabbanan: "sela zo litzdaka" — ad shello bata leyad gabbay, muttar leshannotah; mishshebbata leyad gabbay, asur leshannotah.
b: Ini? veha rabbi yannay yazef ufara! shane rabbi yannay, denicha lehu laaniyyim dechamma dimshahe measse umayyte lehu.

Tanu rabbanan: yisrael shehitnaddev menora o ner levet hakkeneset — asur leshannotah. savar rabbi chiyyay bar abba lememar: la shena lidvar harshut vela shena lidvar mitzva. amar leh rav amme: hachi amar rabbi yochanan — lo shanu ella lidvar harshut, aval lidvar mitzva muttar leshannotah.
Middeamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: goy shehitnaddev menora o ner levet hakkeneset, ad shello nishtakka shem bealeha — asur leshannotah, mishshennishtakka shem bealeha — muttar leshannotah.
Lemay? ilema lidvar harshut, may irya goy? afillu yisrael name!
Ella lidvar mitzva, vetama degoy hu defae, aval yisrael dela pae — shappir dame.

Shaazrak tayyaya innaddav sheraga leve chenishta derav yehuda, shanneyeh rachava veikkefed rava. ikka deamri: shanneyeh rava veikkefed rachava, veikka deamri: shanneyuy chazzane defumebdita, veikkefed rachava veikkefed rabba.
Man deshanneyeh savar dela shechiach, uman deikkefed savar zimnin demikkere veate.
Mishna haggoses vehayyotze lehareg — lo niddar velo neerach. rabbi chanina ben akavya omer: neerach, mippene sheddamav ketzuvin. rabbi yose omer: noder umaarich umakdish, veim hizzik — chayyayv.
Gemara bishlama goses lo niddar — delav bar damim hu, velo neerach — delav bar haamada vehaaracha hu, ella yotze lehareg, bishlama lo niddar — delav bar damim hu, ella lo neerach ammay la?
Detanya: minnayin hayyotze lehareg veamar "erki alay", shello amar kelum? talmud lomar: "kol cherem lo yippade". yachol afillu kodem shennigmar dino? talmud lomar: "min haadam", velo kol haadam.
Ulerabbi chanina ben akavya, deamar neerach mippene sheddamav ketzuvin, hay "kol cherem" may aved leh?

Lechidtanya, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: lefi shemmatzinu lammumatim bide shamayim shennotnin mamon umitkapper lahem, shenneemar "im kofer yushat alav", yachol af bide adam ken? talmud lomar "kol cherem lo yippade".
En li ella mitot chamurot, shello nittena shiggatan lechappara, mitot kallot, shennittena shiggatan lechappara, minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol cherem".
Rabbi yose omer: noder umaarich kulei. vetanna kamma mi kaamar dela?
Ella, benoder umaarich umikkaddish — kulle alma la peligi, ki feligi — beim hizzik. tanna kamma savar: im hizzik — eno chayyayv betashlumin, verabbi yose savar: im hizzik — chayyayv betashlumin.
Bemay kamippalgi? amar rav yosef: bemilva al pe gove min hayyorshin kamippalgi, tanna kamma savar: milva al pe eno gove min hayyorshin, verabbi yose savar: milva al pe gove min hayyorshin.

Rava amar: dechulle alma milva al pe eno gove min hayyorshin, vehacha bemilva ketuva battora kamippalgi, tanna kamma savar: milva ketuva battora lav kichtuva bishtar damya, verabbi yose savar: kichtuva bishtar damya.

Veikka dematne la aha: hayyotze lehareg, hu shechaval baacherim — chayyayv, acherim shechavlu bo — peturin. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af hu im chaval baacherim — patur, shello nittan lachazarat amidat bet din.

a: Mikkelal detanna kamma savar: nittan lachazarat amidat bet din?!
Amar rav yosef: bemilva al pe gove min hayyorshin kamippalgi, tanna kamma savar: milva al pe gove min hayyorshin, verabbi shimon ben elazar savar: eno gove min hayyorshin.

Rabba amar: dechulle alma milva al pe eno gove min hayyorshin, vehacha bemilva hakketuva battora kichtuva bishtar kamippalgi, tanna kamma savar: kichtuva bishtar damya, verabbi shimon ben elazar savar: lav kichtuva bishtar damya.
Metivi: hachofer bor birshut harabbim, venafal alav shor vaharago — patur, velo od, ella sheim met hashshor — yorshe baal habbor chayyayvin leshallem deme shor livalav!
Amar rabbi ila amar rav: kesheamad baddin, veha "harago" katane! amar rav adda bar ahava: kesheasao terefa.
Vehaamar rav nachman, tane chagga: met ukevaro! vehilcheta deyaytvi dayyayne appumma devera.
Tanu rabbanan: hayyotze lehareg — mazzin alav middam chattato umiddam ashamo, chata beotah shaa — en nizkakin lo. may tama? amar rav yosef: mippene sheen meannin et dino.
Amar leh abbaye: i hachi, afillu resha name! kegon shehaya zivcho zavuach beotah shaa.
Aval en zivcho zavuach, may? la? addetane "chata beotah shaa en nizkakin lo", liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa, aval en zevach zavuach — lo!
Hachi name kaamar: bamme devarim amurim — shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa, aval en zevach zavuach — naasa kemi shechata beotah shaa, veen nizkakin lo.

Mishna haishsha sheyyatza lehareg, en mamtinin lah ad shetteled. haishsha sheyyashva al hammashber, mamtinin lah ad shetteled. haishsha shenneherga, nehenin bisarah. behema shenneherga, asura bahanaa.
Gemara peshita, gufa hi! itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "kaasher yashit alav baal haishsha", mamona devaal hu, vela layfsedeh minneh, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: amar kera "umetu gam shenehem" — lerabbot et havvavlad.
Vehay mibbee leh, ad sheyyehu shenehen shavin, divre rabbi yoshiyya! ki kaamrinan miggam".
Yashva al hammashber vechulei. may tama? kevan deakar, gufa acharina hu.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: haishsha hayyotza lehareg, makkin otah keneged bet herayon, kede sheyyamut havvavlad techilla, kede shello tavo lide niuul. lememra dehi kadma umeta beresha? veha kayyma lan devavlad mayet beresha!
Ditnan: tinok ben yomo nochel umanchil, veamar rav sheshet: nochel benichse haem lehanechil laachin min haav.
Davvka ben yom echad, aval ubbar — la, dehu mayet beresha, veen habben yoresh et immo bekever lehanechil laachin min haav!
Hane mille legabbe mita, ayyeyde devavlad zutera chayyuteh, ayyla tippa demalach hammavet umechattech lehu lesimanin, aval neherga — hi meta beresha.
Veha hava ovada, ufarkes ad telat pirkuse! midde dehave azzenav halletaa dimfarkeset.
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: haishsha sheyyashva al hammashber umeta beshabbat, meviin sakkin umekarim et keresah, umotziin et havvavlad. peshita, may aved?
b: Mechattech bevasar hu! amar rabba: lo nitzrecha lehavi sakkin derech reshut harabbim.

Umay kamashma lan, demissefeka mechallelinan shabbeta? tenena: mi shennafla alav mappolet, safek hu sham, safek eno sham, safek chay, safek met, safek nochri, safek yisrael — mefakkechin alav et haggal!
Mahu detema: hatam hu dahava leh chazaka dechayyuta, aval hacha dela hava leh chazaka dechayyuta meikkara — ema la, ka mashma lan.
Haishsha shenneherga vechulei. veammay? issure hanaa ninhu! amar rav: beomeret "tenu seari levitti". illu amra "tenu yadi levitti", mi yahavinan la?!
Amar rav: befea nochrit, tama deamra "tenu", ha lo amra "tenu" — gufa hu umittesar.
Veha mibbaya leh lerabbi yose berabbi chanina, devae rabbi yose berabbi chanina: sear nashim tzidkaniyyot mahu?
Veamar rava: befea nochrit la kamibbaya leh, ki kamibbaya leh lerabbi yose berabbi chanina ditle besikketa.
Hacha dimchabbar ba, tama deamra "tenu", ha lo amra "tenu" — gufa hu umittesar.
Kashya leh lerav nachman bar yitzchak, veha dumeya divhema katane, ma hatam gufay — af hacha name gufay!
Ella amar rav nachman: zo mitatah osartah, vezo gemar dina osartah.

Tane levi kevavteh derav, tane levi kevavteh derav nachman bar yitzchak. tane levi kevavteh derav: haishsha sheyyotza lehareg veamra: "tenu seari levitti" — notnin, meta — en notnin, mippene shehammet asur bahanaa.
Peshita! ella shennoye hammet asur bahanaa.
Tanya kevavteh derav nachman bar yitzchak: haishsha shemmeta — nehenin bisarah, behema shenneherga — asura bahanaa; uma hefresh ben ze laze? zo — mitatah osartah, vezo — gamar dina osartah.
Hadaran alach hakkol maarichin.
Mishna en neerachin pachot missela, velo yater al chamishshim sela. ketzad? natan sela veheeshir — eno noten kelum, pachot missela veheeshir — noten chamishshim sela.
Hayu beyadav chamesh selaim, rabbi meir omer: eno noten ella achat, vachachamim omrim: noten et kullan. en neerachin pachot missela, velo yater al chamishshim sela.
Gemara en neerachin pachot missela. menalan? dichtiv: "vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh", kol arachin sheatta maarich lo yehu pechutin mishkal.
Velo yater al chamishshim selaim. dichtiv: "chamishshim".
Hayu beyadav chamishsha kulei. may tama derabbi meir? ketiv "chamishshim" uchetiv "shekel", o chamishshim o shekel.
Verabbanan? hahu, lechol arachin sheatta maarich lo yehu pechutim mishkal hu daata, hecha deit leh — amar kera: "asher tassig yad hannoder", vahare yado masseget.
Verabbi meir? hahu "yad hannoder velo yad hanniddar" hu daata, verabbanan, lav mimmela shamat minna dehecha deyado masseget shekol minneh?
Amar rav adda bar ahava: hayu beyadav chamesh selaim, veamar "erki alay", vechazar veamar "erki alay", venatan arba lashsheniyya veechad larishona — yatza yede shetehen.
May tama? baal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava — ma sheggava gava.
Beiddana deyahev lashsheniyya, meshabad lerishona. beiddana deyahev larishona, tu let leh.

a: Natan arba larishona veachat lashsheniyya — yede sheniyya yatza, yede rishona lo yatza, kullehu meshabedan lerishona.

Bae rav adda bar ahava: hayu beyado chamesh selaim veamar "sheni erki alay" bevat achat, mahu? kevan divvat achat nadar — ki hadade tafsan, yahev tarte ufalga lehay vetarte ufalga lehay, o dilma kullehu chazya lehay vechullehu chazya lehay? teku.
En baarachin pachot missela velo yater kulei. ha tu lema li?
Ha kamashma lan: pachot missela hu delekka, ha yater al sela ikka; yater al chamishshim hu delekka, ha pachot mechamishshim ikka, usetama kerabbanan.
Mishna en "petach betoa" pachot mishshiva, velo yater al shiva asar.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: toa sheamra "yom echad tame raiti", pitchah shiva asar.
"Shene yamim tame raiti" — pitchah shiva asar.
"Shelosha yamim tame raiti" — pitchah shiva asar.
"Arbaa yamim tame raiti" — pitchah shishsha asar.
"Chamishsha yamim tame raiti" — pitchah chamishsha asar. "shishsha yamim tame raiti" — pitchah arbaa asar.
"Shiva yamim tame raiti" — pitchah shelosha asar.
"Shemona yamim tame raiti" — pitchah shenem asar.
"Tisha yamim tame raiti" — pitchah achad asar.
"Asara yamim tame raiti" — pitchah asara. "achad asar" — pitchah tisha.
b: "Shenem asar" — pitchah shemona.
"Shelosha asar" — pitchah shiva.
Sheen petach betoa pachot mishshiva, velo yater al shiva asar.
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerabba: lema li kulle hay? timne shiva vetishtere!
Amar leh: letakkona lide nidda ufitchah kaamrinan.
Tanu rabbanan: kol hattoot zavot, meviot korban veeno neechol, chutz mippitchah shiva ufitchah shemona, shemmeviot korban veneechol.
Attu kol hattoot zavot? vetu, yom echad ushene yamim bat etoye korban hi?
Ella, kol zavot hattoot meviot korban veeno neechol, chutz mippitchah shiva, ufitchah shemona, shemmeviot korban veneechol.
Mishna en bingaim pachot mishshavua echad, velo yater al shelosha shevuot.
Gemara pachot mishshavua — nige adam, velo yater al shelosha shevuot — nige vattim.
Amar rav pappa: "tzidkatcha keharere el" — ellu nige adam, "mishpatecha tehom rabba" — ellu nige vattim.

Peshateh dikra bemay ketiv? amar rav yehuda: ilmale "tzidkatcha keharere el" — mi yuchal laamod lifne "mishpatecha tehom rabba". rabba amar: "tzidkatcha keharere el" — mippene shemmishpatecha tehom rabba".
Bemay kamippalgi? bidrabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina, deittemar: rabbi elazar amar: kovesh, rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: nose.
Rabba kerabbi elazar, verav yehuda kerabbi yose berabbi chanina.

Mishna en pochatin mearbaa chodashim hameubbarim beshana, velo nira yater al shemona. shete hallechem en neechalin pachot mishshenayim, velo yater al shelosha. lechem happanim en neechol pachot mittisha, velo yater al achad asar.
In katan nimmol pachot mishshemona, velo yater al shenem asar.
Gemara may "lo nira yater al shemona"? amar rav huna: lo nira lachachamim leabber yater al shemona. may shena tisha dela? im ken

a: Kadem ate sehara telata yome! hasheta name ka kadem ate tere yome.

Kidamar rav mesharsheya, kegon shehayta shana meubberet, hacha name kegon shehayta shana shellefaneha meubberet, veibbur shana chodesh. dal yarcha malya bahade yarcha chassira, veakkatti chad yoma! la addatayyhu deinashe.
Ulla amar: lo nira lachachamim lechasser yater al shemona, umay tama kaamar — ma taam en pochatim mearbaa chodashim hameubbarim beshana — mishshum delo nira lachachamim lechasser yater al shemone.
May shena tisha dela, deim ken meyaytra sehara telata yome, hasheta name ka meyaytra tere yome!
Kidamar rav mesharsheya, kegon shehayta shana meubberet, hacha name kegon shehayta shana shellefaneha meubberet, dal yarcha chassira bahade yarcha malya.
Veakkatti ikka chad yoma, savri: itchazoye itchazi vaanan lav addatin.
b: Bemay kamippalgi? beibbur shana, detanya: kamma ibbur shana — sheloshim, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: chodesh.
Metivi: in atzeret chala ella beyom hanef, veen rosh hashshana chala ella o beyom hanef o leor ibburo. bishlama leulla, dishmona chaserin avdinan, meubbarin la avdinan — mashkachat la.
Shenehen chaser — beyom hanef.
Echad male veechad chaser — leor ibburo.
Ella lerav huna deamar: avdinan meubbarin, ha zimnin demashkachat leor or ibburo!
Amar lecha rav huna: uleulla mi nicha? shemona hu dela avdinan, ha shiva avdinan. shiva zimnin dela avdinan besitva veavdinan bekayyta, veha hava leor or ibburo!
Ella, ha manni? acherim hi, detanya: acherim omrim: en ben atzeret laatzeret, veen ben rosh hashshana lerosh hashshana, ella arbaa yamim bilvad, veim hayta shana meubberet — chamishsha.
Sof sof, laacherim, beyom hanef — la mashkachat la!
Amar rav mesharsheya: kegon shehayta shana meubberet, veibbur shana sheloshim yom, dal yarcha levahade yarcha, demashkachat lah beyom hanef.
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava: "acherim", minyana ata leashmoinan? ha ka mashma lan, dela baenan mitzva lekaddesh al pi haraya.
Matkef la ravina vehaikka yoma deshae, veyoma ditlatin shene, kevan deleteh bechol shatta la ka chashev.
Veaf shemuel savar la kerav huna, deamar shemuel: en shenat levana pechuta mishshelosh meot vachamishshim ushetayim yom, velo yetera al shelosh meot vachamishshim veshishsha yom.
Ha ketzad? shenehem melein — shishsha, shenehem chaserin — shenayim, echad male veechad chaser — arbaa.

Metivi: hareni nazir "kimot hachamma" — mone nezirut shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha yamim, keminyan yemot hachamma. "kimot hallevana" — mone nezirut shelosh meot vachamishshim vearbaa yamim, keminyan yemot hallevana. veim ita, zimnin demashkachat la shishsha!
Bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam, verov shanim.

Veaf rabbi savar la kerav huna, detanya: maase veasa rabbi (kerav huna) tisha chaserim, venira chodesh bizmanno, vehaya rabbi tameah veomer: asinu tisha chaserin venire chodesh bizmanno! amar lefanav rabbi shimon bar rabbi: shemma shana meubberet hayta?

a: Veibbur shana sheloshim (ayshatekad) [veishtakad] asinu shenehem melein, dal telata levahade telata vekam leh beducheteh. amar leh: ner yisrael! ken have.
Mishna en pochatin meesrim veachat tekiot bammikdash, velo mosifin al arbaim ushemone.

En pochatin mishshene nevalim, velo mosifin al shishsha. en pochatin mishshene chalilin, velo mosifin al shenem asar, uvishnem asar yom bashshana hechalil makke lifne hammizbeach: bishchitat pesach rishon, uvishchitat pesach sheni, veyom tov harishon shel pesach, uveyom tov shel atzeret, uvishmonat yeme hechag. velo haya makke beabbuv shel nechoshet, ella beabbuv shel kane, mippene shekkolo arev; velo haya mechallek ella beabbuv yechidi, mippene shehu mechallek yafe.
Veavde kohanim hayu, divre rabbi meir; rabbi yose omer: mishpachat bet pegarim uvet tzippera meemmaum hayu massiin lakkehunna; rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: leviyyim hayu.
