Gemara: matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda, detanya: rabbi yehuda omer: lo yifchot mishsheva, velo yosif al shesh esre.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi yehuda savar: tekia terua utekia chada hi, verabbanan savri: tekia lechud, uterua lechud, utekia lechud.
May tama derabbi yehuda? ketiv "utekatem terua", uchetiv "terua yitkeu" (lachem), shema minna: tekia terua utekia — chada hi. verabbanan? hahu lifshuta lefaneha ufeshuta leachareha hu daata.
Verabbanan may tama? dichtiv: "uvehakhil et hakkahal titkeu velo tariu", vei salka datach tekia terua utekia chada hi, amar rachamana aved palga demitzva? verabbi yehuda — simana bealma hu.
Keman azla ha deamar rav kahana: en ben tekia litrua velo kelum? keman? kerabbi yehuda. peshita!
Mahu detema: afillu kerabbanan atya, uleappoke midderabbi yochanan deamar: shama tesha tekiot betesha shaot bayyom — yatza. ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! im ken, may "velo kelum"?
Shenem asar yom bashshana makke bechalil vechulei. may shena hane? hoil veyachid gomer bahen et hahallel.

Deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: shemona asar yamim shehayyachid gomer bahen et hahallel: shemona yeme hachag, ushemona yeme chanukka, veyom tov harishon shel pesach, veyom tov (harishon) shel atzeret; uvaggola esrim veechad: tisha yeme hachag, ushemona yeme chanukka, ushene yamim tovim shel pesach, ushene yamim tovim shel atzeret.
May shena bechag deamrinan kol yoma, umay shena befesach dela amrinan
b: Kol yoma? dechag chalukin bekorbenotehen, defesach en chalukin bekorbenotehen.
Shabbat dachaluka bekarbenoteha, lema! la ikkeri "moed".

Rosh chodesh deikkeri "moed", lema! la ikkaddaysh baasiyyayt melacha, dichtiv: "hashshir yihye lachem kelel hitkaddesh chag" — layla hamekuddash lechag taun shira, vesheen mekuddash lechag en taun shira.
Rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, deikkero "moed", veikkaddush baasiyyayt melacha, lema! mishshum derabbi avahu.

Deamar rabbi avahu, amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, mippene ma en yisrael omrim shira lefanecha berosh hashshana uveyom hakkippurim? amar lahen: efshar, melech yoshev al kisse haddin, vesifre chayyim vesifre metim petuchin lefanav, veyisrael omrim shira lefanay?
Veha chanukka dela hachi vela hachi, vekaamar! mishshum nissa. purim deikka nissa, lema! amar rabbi yitzchak: lefi sheen omrim shira al nes shebbechutza laaretz.

Matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: vahare yetziat mitzrayim, denes shebbechutza laaretz hu, veamrinan hallel! kidtanya: ad shello nichnesu yisrael laaretz — hucheshru kol haaratzot lomar shira, mishshennichnesu learetz — lo hucheshru kol aratzot lomar shira.
Rav nachman amar: keriyyaytah zo hi hallela. rava amar: bishlama hatam "halelu avde Adonai" — velo avde faro, hacha "halelu avde Adonai" — velo avde achashverosh? akkatti avde achashverosh anan!
Ulerav nachman deamar: keriyyaytah zo hi hallela, hatanya: mishshennichnesu learetz lo hucheshru kol aratzot lomar shira, kevan sheggalu chazru lehetteran harishon.
Lo haya makke beabbuv shel nechoshet vechulei. patach bechalil umesayyem beabbuv. amar rav pappa: hayeynu chalil hayeynu abbuv, veammay kare leh "chalil"? dachale kaleh.

Tanu rabbanan: abbuv haya bammikdash, chalak haya, dak haya, shel kane haya, umimot moshe haya. tzivva hammelech vetzippuhu zahav, velo haya kolo arev, natlu et tzippuyo vehaya kolo arev kemot shehaya. tziltzol haya bammikdash, shel nechoshet haya, vehaya kolo arev, venifgam, veshalchu chachamim veheviu ummanin mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim vetikkenuhu, velo haya kolo arev, natlu et tikkuno vehaya kolo arev kemot shehaya.

Machteshet hayta bemikdash, shel nechoshet hayta, umimot moshe hayta, vehayta mefattemet et habbesamim, nitpaggema veheviu ummanin mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim vetiknuha, velo hayta mefattemet kemo shehayta, natlu et tikkunah vehayta mefattemet kemo shehayta.

Ellu shene chelim nishtayyeyru mimmikdash rishon, venitpaggemu velo haya lahem arucha, vaalehem amar david: "nechoshet memorat", "nechoshet memorak", vaalehem hu omer: "uchele nechoshet mutzehav shenayim chamudot mizzahav".
Rav ushemuel, chad amar: kol echad veechad shakul kishnayim shel zahav, vechad amar: shenehem shekulin keechad shel zahav. tane rav yosef: shenehem shekulin keechad shel zahav.
Tanya, rabbi natan omer: sheniyyim hayu, shenneemar: "shenayim", al tikre "shenayim" ella "sheniyyim".

Tane rabban shimon ben gamliel: shiloach haya mekalleach mayim bichissar, tzivva hammelech vehirchivuhu kede sheyyitrabbu memav, venitmaatu, vechazru umiatuhu vehaya mekalleach mayim, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "al yithallel chacham bechochmato veal yithallel gibbor bigvurato".
Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hirdavlim lo haya bemikdash. may hirdavlim? amar abbaye: tavla guregdana, mippene shekkolo arev umearbev et hanneima.
Amar rava bar shela amar rav matna amar shemuel: magrefa hayta bammikdash,

a: Asara nekavim hayu bah, kol echad veechad motzi asara mine zemer, nimtzet kullah motzia mea mine zemer. bematnita tana: hi amma ugevoha amma, vekatta yotza hemenna, vaasara nekavim hayu bah, kol echad motzi mea mine zemer, nimtzet kullah motzia elef mine zemer. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vesimanaych matnita guzema.
Veavde chohanim hayu kulei. lema beha kamippalgi, deman deamar avadim hayu kasavar: ikkar shira bappe, ucheli levassome kala hu daavida, uman deamar leviyyim hayu kasavar: ikkar shira bichli!
Vetisbera? rabbi yose may kasavar? i kasavar: ikkar shira bappe — avadim saggi, i kasavar: ikkar shira bichli — leviyyim baenan!
Leolam kasavar: ikkar shira bappe, vehacha bemaalin midduchan leyuchasin ulemaasrot kamippalgi.

Man deamar avadim hayu, kasavar: en maalin midduchan lo leyuchasin velo lemaasrot. man deamar leviyyim hayu, kasavar: maalin midduchan ben leyuchasin ben lemaasrot. uleman deamar yisreelim hayu, kasavar: maalin midduchan leyuchasin velo lemaasrot.
Tanu rabbanan: hashshir meakkev et hakkorban, divre rabbi meir; vachachamim omrim: eno meakkev.
May tama derabbi meir? deamar kera: "vaettena et haleviyyim netunim leaharon ulevanav mittoch bene yisrael... ulechapper al bene yisrael", ma kappara meakkevet, af shira meakkevet.
Verabbanan? hahu leiddach derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: ma kappara bayyom, af shira bayyom.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: minnayin leikkar shira min hattora? shenneemar: "vesheret beshem Adonai elohav", ezehu sherut shebbeshem? heve omer: zo shira.
Veema nesiut kappayim! middichtiv: "lesharto ulevarech bishmo", mikkelal devirkat kohanim lav sherut hi.

Rav matna amar mehacha: "tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav", ezo hi avoda shebbesimcha uvetuv levav? heve omer: zo shira. veema divre tora, dichtiv: "pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev"! "mesammeche lev" ikkeri, "tov" la ikkeri.
Veema bikkurim, dichtiv: "vesamachta vechol hattov"! "tov" ikkeri, "tuv levav" la ikkeri.
Amar rav matna: minnayin labbikkurim shetteunin shira? atya "tov" "tov" mehacha.

Ini? veha amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin sheen omrim shira ella al hayyayin? shenneemar: "vattomer lahem haggefen hechodalti et tiroshi hamesammeach elohim vaanashim", im anashim mesammeach, elohim bamme mesammeach? mikkan sheen omrim shira ella al hayyayin.
Mashkachat la, kidtane rabbi yose: "peri atta mevi, vei atta mevi mashkin"; hevi anavim uderachan, minnayin? talmud lomar: "tavi".
Chizkiyya amar mehacha: "uchenanyahu sar haleviyyim yasor bammassa ki mevin hu", al tikre "yasor" ella "yashir".
Bilvavte amar rabbi yochanan, mehacha: "laavod avodat avoda", ezehu avoda shetztzericha avoda? heve omer: zo shira.
Rabbi yitzchak amar mehacha: "seu zimra utenu tof kinnor naim im navel". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha: "hem yisu kolam yaronnu bigon Adonai tzahalu miyyam".

Vetanna mayyte la mehacha: "velivne kehat lo natan ki avodat hakkodesh alehem bakkatef yissau", mimmashma shenneemar "bakkatef" eni yodea sheyyisu"? ma talmud lomar "yissau"? en "yissau" ella leshon shira, vechen hu omer: "seu zimra utenu tof", veomer: "yisseu kolam yaronnu vegomer".
Chananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua amar, mehacha: "moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol",
b: Al iske kol. rav ashe amar, mehacha: "vayhi cheechad lamchatztzetzorim velamshorrim lehashemia kol echad".
Rabbi yonatan amar mehacha: "velo yamutu gam hem gam attem" — ma attem baavodat mizbeach, af hem baavodat mizbeach.
Tanya name hachi: "velo yamutu gam hem gam attem" — attem beshellahem vehem beshellachem bemita, hem beshellahem enan bemita ella beazhara.

Amar abbaye: nekitinan, meshorer sheshshier beshel chavero bemita, shenneemar: "vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma lifne ohel moed vegomer vehazzar hakkarev yumat". may zar? illema zar mammash — hachtiv chada zimna! ella lav zar deotah avoda.
Metivi: meshorer sheshshier umeshoer sheshshorer, enan bemita ella beazhara!

Tannae hi, detanya: maase berabbi yehoshua bar chananya shehalach lesayyea behaggafat delatot etzel rabbi yochanan ben gudegda, amar lo: beni, chazor laachorecha, sheatta min hameshorrim velo min hameshoarim.
May lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar: mita hi, ugezaru ba rabbanan, umar savar: azhara hi, vela gezaru ba?
Dechulle alma azhara hi, mar savar: mesayyea gezaru beh rabbanan, umar savar: la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Bae rabbi avin: olat nidvat tzibbur teuna shira o enah teuna shira? "olotechem" amar rachamana, achat olat chova veachat olat nedava, o dilma "olotechem" dechullehu yisrael kaamar rachamana?

Ta shema, vayyomer: "chizkiyyahu lehaalot haola al hammizbeach, uveet hechel haola hechel shir Adonai vehachatzotzrot al yede kele shir david melech yisrael". hay shira may avidta? illema deolat chova, lema leh immeloche? ella lav deolat nedava.
Amar rav yosef: lo, olat rosh chodesh hava, veka mibbaya lehu mi hukeba rosh chodesh bizmanno delikrav o la.
Amar leh abbaye: umi matzet amrat hachi? vehachtiv "bayyom shishsha asar lachodesh harishon vegomer", "vayyomer chizkiyyahu lehaalot haola al hammizbeach"!
Ella amar rame bereh derav yeva: keves habba im haomer kamibbaya lehu, mi kava rosh chodesh bizmanno delikrayv o la?
Matkef la rav avya: velichze pesach hechi aved, matztza hechi achel!
Ella amar rav ashe: midde dehave ashshelicha detzibbura demimmelich. hasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema olat chova, midde dehave ashshelicha detzibbura demimmelich.
Ta shema: rabbi yose omer: megalgelin zechut leyom zakkay, vechova leyom chayyayv.

Amru: keshecharav habbayit barishona, oto hayyom tisha beav haya, umotzae shabbat haya, umotzae sheviit hayta, umishmarto shel yehoyariv hayta, vehayu kohanim uleviyyim omdim al duchanan veomrim shira, uma shira amru? "vayyashev alehem et onam uveraatam yatzmitem", velo hispiku lomar "yatzmitem Adonai elohenu" ad shebbau goyim uchevashum, vechen bashsheniyya.
Hay shira may avidtay? illema deolat chova, mi havay? beshiva asar betammuz batal hattamid! ella lav deolat nedava.
Vetisbera?! may shena deolat chova dela havay, umay shena deolat nedava dahavay? ha la kashya: ben bakar akray bealma hu deitremi lehu.
Amar rava, veittema rav ashe: vetisbera, shira deyomeh "laAdonai haaretz umeloah", vayyashev alehem et onam — beshir dearbea beshabbat hu! ella ilyay bealma hu dinfal lehu befummayyhu.
Veha "omdin al duchanan" katane! kidresh lakish, deamar: omer shello al hakkorban. i hachi, beolat nedava name lema? nafek minna chureba.
May hava ala? ta shema, detane rav mari bereh derav kahana: "al olotechem veal zivche shalmechem".
Ma ola kodesh kadashim — af shelamim kodesh kodashim, uma shelamim kavua lahem zeman — af ola kavua lah zeman.
